{"lines":[{"lineId":"7","lineNum":8,"lineType":1,"content":"皇極經世書十四卷，宋邵雍撰。邵","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"8","lineNum":10,"lineType":1,"content":"子數學，本於李挺之、穆修，而其源出於陳搏。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"9","lineNum":12,"lineType":1,"content":"當李挺之初見邵子於百泉，即授以義理性","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"10","lineNum":14,"lineType":1,"content":"命之學。其作皇極經世，盖出於物理之學，所","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"11","lineNum":16,"lineType":1,"content":"謂易外别傳者是也。其書以元經㑹，以㑹經","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"12","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426448309176500265"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"13","lineNum":20,"lineType":1,"content":"運，以運經世，起於帝堯甲辰，至後周顯徳六","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"14","lineNum":22,"lineType":1,"content":"年已未，而興亡治亂之蹟，皆以卦象推之。朱","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"15","lineNum":24,"lineType":1,"content":"子謂皇極是推步之書，可謂能得其要領。朱","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"16","lineNum":26,"lineType":1,"content":"子又嘗謂：自易以後，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"17","lineNum":26,"lineType":1,"content":"無人做得一物如此整","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"18","lineNum":28,"lineType":1,"content":"齊，包括得盡。又謂：康節易看了，却看别人的","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"19","lineNum":30,"lineType":1,"content":"不得。而張㟭亦謂：此書本以天道，質以人事，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"20","lineNum":32,"lineType":1,"content":"辭約而義廣，天下之能事畢矣。盖自邵子始","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"21","lineNum":34,"lineType":1,"content":"為此學，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"22","lineNum":34,"lineType":1,"content":"其後自張行成、祝泌等數家以外，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"23","lineNum":34,"lineType":1,"content":"能","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"24","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426448287915507727"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"25","lineNum":38,"lineType":1,"content":"明其理者甚鮮，故世人卒莫窮其作用之所","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"26","lineNum":40,"lineType":1,"content":"以然。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"27","lineNum":40,"lineType":1,"content":"其起而議之者，則曰元㑹運世之分，無","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"28","lineNum":42,"lineType":1,"content":"所依據。十二萬九千餘年之説，近於釋氏之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"29","lineNum":44,"lineType":1,"content":"刼數；水、火、土、石，本於釋氏之地、水、火、風。且五","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"30","lineNum":46,"lineType":1,"content":"行何以去金、去木？乾在易為天，而經世為日；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"31","lineNum":48,"lineType":1,"content":"兑在易為澤，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"32","lineNum":48,"lineType":1,"content":"而經世為月。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"33","lineNum":48,"lineType":1,"content":"以至離之為星，震","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"34","lineNum":50,"lineType":1,"content":"之為辰，坤之為水，艮之為火，坎之為土，巽之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"35","lineNum":52,"lineType":1,"content":"為石，其取象多不與易相同，俱難免於牽強","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"36","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426448295792427042"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"37","lineNum":56,"lineType":1,"content":"不合。然邵子在當日用以占驗，無不竒中，故","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"38","lineNum":58,"lineType":1,"content":"厯代皆重其書。且其自述大㫖，亦不專於象","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"39","lineNum":60,"lineType":1,"content":"數。如云：天下之事，始過於重，猶卒於輕；始過","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"40","lineNum":62,"lineType":1,"content":"於厚，猶卒於薄。又云：學以人事為大。又云：治","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"41","lineNum":64,"lineType":1,"content":"生於亂，亂生於治，聖人貴未然之防，是謂易","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"42","lineNum":66,"lineType":1,"content":"之大綱。又云：天下將治，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"43","lineNum":66,"lineType":1,"content":"則人必尚義也；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"44","lineNum":66,"lineType":1,"content":"天下","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"45","lineNum":68,"lineType":1,"content":"將亂，則人必尚利也。尚義則謙讓之風行焉，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"46","lineNum":70,"lineType":1,"content":"尚利則攘奪之風行焉。類皆立義正大，垂訓","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"47","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426448318944804900"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"48","lineNum":74,"lineType":1,"content":"深切。是經世一書，雖明天道，而實責成於人","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"49","lineNum":76,"lineType":1,"content":"事，洵粹然儒者之言，固非䜟緯術數家所可","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"50","lineNum":78,"lineType":1,"content":"同年而語也。乾隆四十六年四月恭校上。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"51","lineNum":80,"lineType":1,"content":"總纂官","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"52","lineNum":80,"lineType":2,"content":"臣","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"53","lineNum":80,"lineType":1,"content":"紀昀、","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"54","lineNum":80,"lineType":2,"content":"臣","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"55","lineNum":80,"lineType":1,"content":"陸錫熊、","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"56","lineNum":80,"lineType":2,"content":"臣","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"57","lineNum":80,"lineType":1,"content":"孫士毅，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"58","lineNum":82,"lineType":1,"content":"總　校　官","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"59","lineNum":82,"lineType":2,"content":"臣","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"60","lineNum":82,"lineType":1,"content":"陸　費　墀。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"6","lineNum":9,"lineType":1,"content":"經元之甲，一","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"7","lineNum":11,"lineType":1,"content":"經㑹之午，七","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"8","lineNum":13,"lineType":1,"content":"經運之辛，一百八十八","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"9","lineNum":15,"lineType":1,"content":"經世之子二千二百四十五。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"10","lineNum":17,"lineType":1,"content":"甲子，晉惠帝十四年河間王顒廢皇后羊氏及皇太子","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"11","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426448639293227059"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"12","lineNum":21,"lineType":1,"content":"覃，徙之金墉。表成都王穎為太弟，加九錫，鎮鄴，改","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"13","lineNum":23,"lineType":1,"content":"元永安。右衛將軍陳眕復羊氏皇后及覃太子，大","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"14","lineNum":25,"lineType":1,"content":"㑹司徒王戎及東海王越、高密王簡、平昌公模、呉","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"15","lineNum":27,"lineType":1,"content":"王晏、豫章王熾、襄陽王範、左僕射荀藩八部兵奉","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"16","lineNum":29,"lineType":1,"content":"帝北伐鄴師敗于湯隂，嵆紹死之。帝如北軍，穎以","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"17","lineNum":31,"lineType":1,"content":"帝歸鄴，攺元建武。顒將張方入洛，復廢皇后羊氏","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"18","lineNum":33,"lineType":1,"content":"及覃太子。安北將軍王浚、東瀛公騰以烏丸兵攻","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"19","lineNum":35,"lineType":1,"content":"鄴，穎師敗，帝還洛陽。河間王使張方徙帝西都長","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"20","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426448638924062739"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"21","lineNum":39,"lineType":1,"content":"安，亦復羊氏皇后及永安年號，廢穎太弟，以豫章","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"22","lineNum":41,"lineType":1,"content":"王熾為太弟，攺元永興。王戎豫朝政，始分東西臺。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"23","lineNum":43,"lineType":1,"content":"是年，李雄逐羅尚于成都，稱王單于。左賢王劉淵","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"24","lineNum":45,"lineType":1,"content":"稱王離石，國曰漢，元曰元熙。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"25","lineNum":47,"lineType":1,"content":"乙丑，東海王越嚴兵徐方，范陽王虓抗師許昌，成都王","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"26","lineNum":49,"lineType":1,"content":"潁擁兵河間北，河間王顒又復廢羊氏皇后，以穎","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"27","lineNum":51,"lineType":1,"content":"為大將軍，都督河北。虓、越將周權入洛，又復羊氏","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"28","lineNum":53,"lineType":1,"content":"皇后。洛陽令何喬殺周權，又廢羊氏皇后。虓、越兵","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"29","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426448638924029971"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"30","lineNum":57,"lineType":1,"content":"攻潁不已，穎敗，棄鄴走洛陽。虓、越攻洛陽，穎奔顒","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"31","lineNum":59,"lineType":1,"content":"于長安。漢劉淵攻晉劉琨于板橋，不利。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"32","lineNum":61,"lineType":1,"content":"丙寅，東海王越、范陽王虓兵攻長安，河間王顒、成都王","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"33","lineNum":63,"lineType":1,"content":"穎走南山。虓、越將祁𢎞、宋胄以帝東還洛陽，復以","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"34","lineNum":65,"lineType":1,"content":"羊氏為皇后，攺元光熈。越稱太傅、録尚書事，專制。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"35","lineNum":67,"lineType":1,"content":"虓為司空，卒。越遂弑帝，立太弟熾，是謂懷帝。引温","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"36","lineNum":69,"lineType":1,"content":"羡為司徒，王衍為司空。顒、穎野死。李雄稱帝成都，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"37","lineNum":71,"lineType":1,"content":"國曰蜀，元曰太武，謂之後蜀。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"38","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426448624000811045"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"39","lineNum":75,"lineType":1,"content":"丁卯，晉攺元永嘉。東海王越稱大丞相，鎮許昌，以后父","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"40","lineNum":77,"lineType":1,"content":"梁芬為太尉。成都王黨汲桑陷鄴。王彌稱兵青、徐。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"41","lineNum":79,"lineType":1,"content":"漢劉淵破晉河東諸郡。晉劉琨獨保晉陽。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"42","lineNum":81,"lineType":1,"content":"戊辰，劉淵稱帝蒲子，改元永鳳，㧞晉平陽居之。王彌、石","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"43","lineNum":83,"lineType":1,"content":"勒附于漢。石勒攻常山。王彌攻洛陽，焚建春門。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"44","lineNum":85,"lineType":1,"content":"己巳，東海王越入洛，殺大臣十餘人，以左僕射山簡征","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"45","lineNum":87,"lineType":1,"content":"東大將軍、都督荆州，南鎮襄陽。漢劉淵改元河瑞。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"46","lineNum":89,"lineType":1,"content":"石勒兵出鉅鹿，王彌兵出上黨，劉聰兵出壺關，同","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"47","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426448638924177427"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"48","lineNum":93,"lineType":1,"content":"攻晉洛陽。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"49","lineNum":95,"lineType":1,"content":"庚午，東海王越徵兵天下，諸侯咸無從者，自率兵出許","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"50","lineNum":97,"lineType":1,"content":"昌。漢劉淵卒，子和繼。叔楚王聰殺和代立，改元光","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"51","lineNum":99,"lineType":1,"content":"興。以北海王義為皇太弟，劉曜為相國，石勒為大","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"52","lineNum":101,"lineType":1,"content":"將軍。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"53","lineNum":103,"lineType":1,"content":"辛未，天下亂，晉詔兖州茍晞㑹諸侯兵伐許昌，㑹東海","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"54","lineNum":105,"lineType":1,"content":"王越卒，乃止。是年，洛陽陷，王衍為軍帥，王師十二","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"55","lineNum":107,"lineType":1,"content":"敗，帝及傳國六璽皆沒于寇。長安亦陷，南陽王模","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"56","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426448638924128275"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"57","lineNum":111,"lineType":1,"content":"亦没于寇。漢劉曜、王彌、石勒㧞晉洛陽，俘其帝于","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"58","lineNum":113,"lineType":1,"content":"平陽。攺元嘉平。劉曜㧞晉長安，保之。石勒害王彌","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"59","lineNum":115,"lineType":1,"content":"于己吾，而幷其衆。蜀李雄㧞晉梓潼及涪城。攺元","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"60","lineNum":117,"lineType":1,"content":"玉衡。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"61","lineNum":119,"lineType":1,"content":"壬申，晉懷帝在平陽，賈疋逐劉曜于長安三輔，與閻鼎、","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"62","lineNum":121,"lineType":1,"content":"梁芬、梁綜、麴允共奉秦王鄴為皇太子，以入長安。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"63","lineNum":123,"lineType":1,"content":"鎮東將軍瑯琊王𥈠帥亡衆大集壽春。茍晞保蒙","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"64","lineNum":125,"lineType":1,"content":"城，不利，降于石勒。劉琨保晉陽，不利，奔常山。拓䟦","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"65","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426448620339167232"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"66","lineNum":129,"lineType":1,"content":"猗盧以兵六萬來救，大敗劉曜、劉粲于狼猛，劉琨","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"67","lineNum":131,"lineType":1,"content":"復保陽曲。漢劉聰納劉殷女二人為皇后，孫四人","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"68","lineNum":133,"lineType":1,"content":"為貴妃，㧞晉太原，復失之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"69","lineNum":135,"lineType":1,"content":"癸酉，晉懷帝死于平陽，皇太子鄴稱帝長安，是謂愍帝，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"70","lineNum":137,"lineType":1,"content":"攺元建興。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"71","lineNum":137,"lineType":1,"content":"以梁芬為司徒，麴允為使持節、領軍、録","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"72","lineNum":139,"lineType":1,"content":"尚書事，索綝為尚書左僕射，瑯琊王𥈠為左丞相、","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"73","lineNum":141,"lineType":1,"content":"都督陜東諸軍事，南陽王保為右丞相、都督陜西","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"74","lineNum":143,"lineType":1,"content":"諸軍事。山東郡縣悉陷于寇。漢石勒鎮襄國。曹嶷","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"75","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426448620339216384"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"76","lineNum":147,"lineType":1,"content":"攻下三齊，據有廣固。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"77","lineNum":149,"lineType":1,"content":"甲戌，晉以瑯琊王𥈠為大司馬，荀組為司空，劉琨為大","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"78","lineNum":151,"lineType":1,"content":"將軍，封凉州，張軌為太尉、西平郡王。軌卒，子寔繼，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"79","lineNum":153,"lineType":1,"content":"稱西河王，國曰凉，元曰永興，城姑臧，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"80","lineNum":153,"lineType":1,"content":"是謂前凉。漢","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"81","lineNum":155,"lineType":1,"content":"劉聰立三皇后，攺元建元。劉曜圍晉長安，石勒圍","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"82","lineNum":157,"lineType":1,"content":"晉幽州。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"83","lineNum":159,"lineType":1,"content":"乙亥，晉進左丞相、瑯琊王𥈠都督中外諸軍事，右丞相、","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"84","lineNum":161,"lineType":1,"content":"南陽王保為相國，司空荀組為太尉、大將軍，劉琨","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"85","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426448624684548105"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"86","lineNum":165,"lineType":1,"content":"為司空。陶侃平江表，獲杜弢。漢劉聰立七皇后，授","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"87","lineNum":167,"lineType":1,"content":"石勒專命，俾征伐。晉勒㧞晉濮陽。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"88","lineNum":169,"lineType":1,"content":"丙子，晉長安陷于寇，帝出降于豆田中。漢劉曜㧞晉長","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"89","lineNum":171,"lineType":1,"content":"安，俘其帝于平陽，攺元麟嘉。石勒㧞晉太原。劉琨","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"90","lineNum":173,"lineType":1,"content":"走幽州，依段匹磾。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"91","lineNum":175,"lineType":1,"content":"丁丑，晉帝在平陽，瑯琊王𥈠渡江，稱晉王于建康，元曰建","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"92","lineNum":177,"lineType":1,"content":"武。以西陽王業為太尉，王敦為大將軍，王導都督","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"93","lineNum":179,"lineType":1,"content":"中外。帝死于平陽。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"94","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426448638924111891"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"95","lineNum":183,"lineType":1,"content":"戊寅，晉王𥈠稱帝于建康，改元太興，以子紹為太子，是","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"96","lineNum":185,"lineType":1,"content":"謂東晉元帝。劉琨為段匹磾所害。王敦稱牧荆州。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"97","lineNum":187,"lineType":1,"content":"王導𨳩府建康。漢劉聰卒，子粲繼，攺元漢昌。將靳","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"98","lineNum":189,"lineType":1,"content":"凖殺粲代立。相國劉曜自長安入至赤壁稱帝，改","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"99","lineNum":191,"lineType":1,"content":"元光初，加大將軍勒九錫，封趙國公。國人誅勒、準","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"100","lineNum":193,"lineType":1,"content":"以迎曜。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"101","lineNum":195,"lineType":1,"content":"己卯，晉南陽王保保祁山，稱晉王。漢劉曜還長安，攺國","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"102","lineNum":197,"lineType":1,"content":"曰趙，是謂前趙。殺石勒使者王循。石勒稱王襄國，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"103","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426448638924161043"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"104","lineNum":201,"lineType":1,"content":"國曰趙，元曰趙，是謂後趙。以張賓為之相，號大執","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"105","lineNum":203,"lineType":1,"content":"法；以弟虎為之將，號元輔。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"106","lineNum":205,"lineType":1,"content":"庚辰，晉南陽王保走桑城死。涼亂，殺張寔，寔弟茂代領","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"107","lineNum":207,"lineType":1,"content":"其衆。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"108","lineNum":209,"lineType":1,"content":"辛巳，晉王導為司空、録尚書事。幽州陷，段匹磾没于石","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lin s":{"PageId":"7426448620591038516"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"225","lineNum":417,"lineType":1,"content":"甲寅，晉太尉桓温伐秦，至灞上，秦苻健敗晉軍于白鹿","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"226","lineNum":419,"lineType":1,"content":"原，又敗之于子午谷。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"227","lineNum":421,"lineType":1,"content":"乙卯，晉將段龕敗燕軍于狼山，右軍王羲之辭官歸。涼","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"228","lineNum":423,"lineType":1,"content":"宋混、張瓘殺張祚，立曜靈弟元靚，改元大始。燕南","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"229","lineNum":425,"lineType":1,"content":"攻晉不利。秦苻健卒，子生繼。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"230","lineNum":427,"lineType":1,"content":"丙辰，晉桓温敗姚襄軍于伊水，遂復洛陽。秦苻生改元","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"231","lineNum":429,"lineType":1,"content":"壽元。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"232","lineNum":431,"lineType":1,"content":"丁巳，晉攺元升平，帝加元服，王彪之為左僕射。燕改元","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"233","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426448624000794661"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"234","lineNum":435,"lineType":1,"content":"光壽，自中山徙都鄴。秦苻生虐用其人，雄子堅殺","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"235","lineNum":437,"lineType":1,"content":"生代立，去帝號，稱天王，改元永興，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"236","lineNum":437,"lineType":1,"content":"以王猛、呂婆樓、","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"237","lineNum":439,"lineType":1,"content":"強汪、梁平老為之輔。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"238","lineNum":441,"lineType":1,"content":"戊午，晉將馮鴦以衆入于燕，燕㧞晉上黨。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"239","lineNum":443,"lineType":1,"content":"己未，晉伐燕不利，燕敗晉于東阿。秦攺元甘露，以王猛","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"240","lineNum":445,"lineType":1,"content":"為中書令，尹京兆。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"241","lineNum":447,"lineType":1,"content":"庚申，晉仇池公楊駿卒，子世繼。燕慕容雋卒，子暐繼，攺","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"242","lineNum":449,"lineType":1,"content":"元建熙。慕容恪為太宰專政。慕容評為太傅，慕容","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"243","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426448624684515337"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"244","lineNum":453,"lineType":1,"content":"根為太師，慕容𡸁為河南大都督。根作逆，伏誅。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"245","lineNum":455,"lineType":1,"content":"辛酉，晉𥡆帝終，立成帝子瑯琊王丕，是謂哀帝。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"246","lineNum":457,"lineType":1,"content":"壬戌，晉攺元隆和。燕師攻晉洛陽。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"247","lineNum":459,"lineType":1,"content":"癸亥，晉攺元興寧。桓温為大司馬，假黃鉞，都督中外軍","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"248","lineNum":461,"lineType":1,"content":"事，北伐。涼張天錫殺元靚代立，攺元太清。燕將慕","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"249","lineNum":463,"lineType":1,"content":"容評攻晉許昌。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"250","lineNum":465,"lineType":1,"content":"經世之寅二千二百四十七","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"251","lineNum":467,"lineType":1,"content":"甲子，東晉哀帝三年。餌丹有疾，太后稱制。燕、秦入㓂洛","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"252","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426448643948838966"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"253","lineNum":471,"lineType":1,"content":"陽。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"254","lineNum":473,"lineType":1,"content":"乙丑， {"lines":[{"lineId":"268","lineNum":499,"lineType":1,"content":"子瑾繼，桓温敗瑾于壽陽。廣漢及","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"269","lineNum":501,"lineType":1,"content":"成都寇亂。王猛滅燕于鄴，徙慕容暐于長安，收郡","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"270","lineNum":503,"lineType":1,"content":"五十七，猛留鎮鄴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"271","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426448643948806198"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"272","lineNum":507,"lineType":1,"content":"辛未，晉桓温平壽陽，獲袁瑾以歸，廢其君弈為海西王，立","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"273","lineNum":509,"lineType":1,"content":"㑹𥟵王昱，攺元咸安，是謂文帝。温稱丞相，鎮姑熟，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"274","lineNum":511,"lineType":1,"content":"專制。殺太宰武陵王晞、新蔡王晃，仍降海西王為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"275","lineNum":513,"lineType":1,"content":"公，及害其二子與母。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"276","lineNum":515,"lineType":1,"content":"壬申，晉命百濟餘句為鎮東將軍，領樂浪守。庾希以海","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"277","lineNum":517,"lineType":1,"content":"陵叛，入于京口。文帝昱終，子曜嗣，是謂武帝。桓温","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"278","lineNum":519,"lineType":1,"content":"還姑熟。秦王猛平慕容桓于遼東，滅仇池公楊纂","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"279","lineNum":521,"lineType":1,"content":"于秦州。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"280","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426448639293161523"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"281","lineNum":525,"lineType":1,"content":"癸酉，晉攺元寧康。大司馬桓温卒，太后稱制。王彪之為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"282","lineNum":527,"lineType":1 ":"西凉。燕慕容徳稱帝廣固，攺元建平。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"383","lineNum":729,"lineType":1,"content":"辛丑，晉平孫恩，劉裕出守下邳。燕慕容盛將叚璣行殺","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"384","lineNum":731,"lineType":1,"content":"盛叔父熙，誅璣稱帝，攺元光始。秦姚興放乞伏乾","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"385","lineNum":733,"lineType":1,"content":"歸還苑川。凉吕超殺其君纂，立其兄隆，攺元神𪔂，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"386","lineNum":735,"lineType":1,"content":"稱藩于姚興。凉秃髮利鹿孤稱河西王。凉大將沮","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"387","lineNum":737,"lineType":1,"content":"渠蒙遜自西安入，殺叚業代立，攺元永安。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"388","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426448624000909349"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"389","lineNum":741,"lineType":1,"content":"壬寅，晉攺元元興。桓𤣥據荆州，建牙夏口，假揚州元顯","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"390","lineNum":743,"lineType":1,"content":"黃鉞。顯軍敗，𤣥入于建業，稱侍中、丞相、録尚書事，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"391","lineNum":745,"lineType":1,"content":"又稱太尉，總百揆。乃殺都督元顯及㑹稽王道子，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"392","lineNum":747,"lineType":1,"content":"以瑯琊王德文為太宰，攺元大亨。劉軌以冀州叛。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"393","lineNum":749,"lineType":1,"content":"秦姚興伐呂光有功，拒魏不利，魏敗秦軍于䝉坑。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"394","lineNum":751,"lineType":1,"content":"凉秃髮利鹿孤卒，弟傉檀立，攺元𢎞昌，徙居樂都。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"395","lineNum":753,"lineType":1,"content":"凉沮渠䝉遜稱藩于姚興。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"396","lineNum":755,"lineType":1,"content":"癸卯，晉加桓𤣥九錫，稱相國、楚王，用天子器服。𤣥竊命，","logicSenten SentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"727","lineNum":1412,"lineType":1,"content":"天成。司徒陳霸先自丹徒入，殺王僧辯，廢蕭明為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"728","lineNum":1414,"lineType":1,"content":"司徒，封建安公，復立方智，攺元紹泰。霸先為尚書，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"729","lineNum":1416,"lineType":1,"content":"都督中外，專制。是年，蕭𧦴稱帝江陵，攺元大定，北","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"730","lineNum":1418,"lineType":1,"content":"附于宇文氏，是謂後南梁。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"731","lineNum":1420,"lineType":1,"content":"丙子，梁改元太平。陳霸先稱相國，敗齊軍于江上。西魏","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"732","lineNum":1422,"lineType":1,"content":"宇文泰卒，子覺繼事。是年，覺代西魏命于長安，是","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"733","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426448661162246144"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"734","lineNum":1426,"lineType":1,"content":"謂閔帝，改國為周，是謂後周，元稱元年，降其君廓","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"735","lineNum":1428,"lineType":1,"content":"為宋國公。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"736","lineNum":1430,"lineType":1,"content":"丁丑，相國陳霸先進爵為陳王。十月，陳霸先代梁命于","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"737","lineNum":1432,"lineType":1,"content":"建業，是謂武帝，攺國為陳，元曰永定，降其君方智","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"738","lineNum":1434,"lineType":1,"content":"為江隂王。周亂，宇文䕶殺其君覺，立宇文毓，是謂","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"739","lineNum":1436,"lineType":1,"content":"明帝，稱元年。䕶為太宰，專制。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"740","lineNum":1438,"lineType":1,"content":"戊寅，梁蕭莊以郢州稱帝，救援于齊。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"741","lineNum":1440,"lineType":1,"content":"巳卯，陳武帝霸先殂，兄臨川王蒨立，是謂文帝，以子伯宗","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"742","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426448638924324883"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"743","lineNum":1444,"lineType":1,"content":"為太子。周宇文毓稱天王，攺元武成。齊宣王洋卒，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"744","lineNum":1446,"lineType":1,"content":"子殷繼于晉陽，以諸父演為太師，湛為司馬。元氏","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"745","lineNum":1448,"lineType":1,"content":"宗室無少長皆殺之，投于漳水。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"746","lineNum":1450,"lineType":1,"content":"庚辰，陳攺元天嘉。周亂，宇文䕶弑其君毓，立其弟邕，是","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"834","lineNum":1618,"lineType":1,"content":"以洛州為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"835","lineNum":1620,"lineType":1,"content":"豫州。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"836","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426448646851330083"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"837","lineNum":1624,"lineType":1,"content":"乙丑，改元大業。冊妃蕭氏為皇后，子晉王昭為皇太子。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"838","lineNum":1626,"lineType":1,"content":"以宇文述為左衛大將軍，郭衍為左武衛大將軍，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"839","lineNum":1628,"lineType":1,"content":"于仲文為右武衛大將軍。尚書令楊素為太子太","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"840","lineNum":1630,"lineType":1,"content":"師，安徳王雄為太子太傅，河間王宏為太子太保。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"841","lineNum":1632,"lineType":1,"content":"遵河由汴渚達于淮，謂之通濟渠。幸東都。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"842","lineNum":1634,"lineType":1,"content":"丙寅，幸江都，還次東都。太子昭卒。封孫侗為越王，侑為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"843","lineNum":1636,"lineType":1,"content":"代王，浩為秦王。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"844","lineNum":1638,"lineType":1,"content":"丁卯，還長安。北廵榆林。作宮于晉陽。光禄賀若弼、禮部","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"845","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426448618292543523"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"846","lineNum":1642,"lineType":1,"content":"郎宇文弼、太常卿高熲伏誅。西北大築亭障。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"847","lineNum":1644,"lineType":1,"content":"戊辰，北廵五原。作宮于汾陽。遵河由清水達于海，謂之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"848","lineNum":1646,"lineType":1,"content":"永濟渠。引沁水南達于河，北通涿郡。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"849","lineNum":1648,"lineType":1,"content":"巳巳，西幸河右，征吐谷渾，至于覆袁。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"850","lineNum":1650,"lineType":1,"content":"庚午，南幸江都。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"851","lineNum":1652,"lineType":1,"content":"辛未，北幸涿郡。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"852","lineNum":1654,"lineType":1,"content":"壬申，以兵百一十三萬三千八百為二十四軍，分左右","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"853","lineNum":1656,"lineType":1,"content":"道，大伐遼東，不利，全陷九軍。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"854","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426448659388039179"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"855","lineNum":1660,"lineType":1,"content":"癸酉，以代王侑留守長安，越王侗留守東都，秦王浩從","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"856","lineNum":1662,"lineType":1,"content":"駕征遼東。復大集兵于涿郡。天下羣盜起。楊𤣥感","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"857","lineNum":1664,"lineType":1,"content":"以本兵叛于黎陽。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"858","lineNum":1666,"lineType":1,"content":"甲戌，高麗請降，乃班師。扶風盜稱帝，延安寇稱王，離石","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"859","lineNum":1668,"lineType":1,"content":"賊稱天子。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"860","lineNum":1670,"lineType":1,"content":"乙亥，北廵。至于雁門，為突厥所圍。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"861","lineNum":1672,"lineType":1,"content":"丙子，南達江都。羣盜李密稱兵河南，竇建徳稱兵河北，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"862","lineNum":1674,"lineType":1,"content":"林士𢎞稱兵江南，徐圓朗稱兵東山，劉武周稱兵","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"863","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426448645261705225"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"864","lineNum":1678,"lineType":1,"content":"代北，薛舉稱兵隴右。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"865","lineNum":1680,"lineType":1,"content":"丁丑，煬帝在江都，唐公李淵自晉陽入，立代王侑于長","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"866","lineNum":1682,"lineType":1,"content":"安，以江都帝為太上皇，攺元義寧，淵稱唐王，專制。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"867","lineNum":1684,"lineType":1,"content":"羣盜竇建徳稱王河北。李密進據興洛，稱公，國曰","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"868","lineNum":1686,"lineType":1,"content":"魏，元曰永平。薛舉稱帝隴右，國曰秦，元曰秦興。梁","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"869","lineNum":1688,"lineType":1,"content":"師都稱兵夏州，李軌稱兵涼州，蕭銑稱兵巴陵，李","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"870","lineNum":1690,"lineType":1,"content":"子通稱兵海陵，朱粲稱兵寇車，沈法興稱兵毗陵，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"871","lineNum":1692,"lineType":1,"content":"杜伏威稱兵厯陽。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"872","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426448643949002806"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"873","lineNum":1696,"lineType":1,"content":"戊寅五月，唐王李淵代隋命于長安，是謂神堯皇帝，改","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"874","lineNum":1698,"lineType":1,"content":"國曰唐，元曰武徳。以裴寂、劉文静為輔相，世子建","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"875","lineNum":1700,"lineType":1,"content":"成為皇太子，次子世民為秦王，降其君為酅國公。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"876","lineNum":1702,"lineType":1,"content":"是年，宇文化及弑煬帝于江都，立秦王浩為主，化","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"877","lineNum":1704,"lineType":1,"content":"及稱王，專制。北轉至魏州，化及又殺浩代立，稱帝，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"878","lineNum":1706,"lineType":1,"content":"國曰許，元曰天壽。又北走聊城，王世充立越王侗","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"879","lineNum":1708,"lineType":1,"content":"于東都，攺元皇泰，世充稱鄭王，專制。羣盜竇建徳","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"880","lineNum":1710,"lineType":1,"content":"進有河北，都樂壽。隴右薛舉卒，子仁果立。劉武周","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"881","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426448658633129993"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"882","lineNum":1714,"lineType":1,"content":"進有河東，稱帝，國曰漢，元曰天興；梁師都進有朔","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"883","lineNum":1716,"lineType":1,"content":"方，稱帝，國曰梁，元曰永隆；李軌進有河右，稱帝，國","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"884","lineNum":1718,"lineType":1,"content":"曰凉，元曰安樂；蕭銑進有江南及嶺表，稱帝，國曰","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"885","lineNum":1720,"lineType":1,"content":"梁，元曰鳴鳳；李子通進有江都，稱帝，國曰呉，元曰","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"886","lineNum":1722,"lineType":1,"content":"明政；朱粲進有山南，稱帝，國曰楚，元曰昌達；沈法","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"887","lineNum":1724,"lineType":1,"content":"興進有江東，稱王，國曰梁，元曰延康；林士𢎞稱帝","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"888","lineNum":1726,"lineType":1,"content":"䖍州，國曰楚，元曰太平；杜伏威進有淮南，受唐封","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"889","lineNum":1728,"lineType":1,"content":"楚王。秦王平隴右，獲薛仁果。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"890","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426448643949019190"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"891","lineNum":1732,"lineType":1,"content":"己卯，唐秦王平河右，獲李軌。李密與王世充相攻不利，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"892","lineNum":1734,"lineType":1,"content":"奔唐，復叛，死于桃林，將徐世勣以河南十郡降。竇","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"893","lineNum":1736,"lineType":1,"content":"建徳滅宇文化及于聊城，自樂壽徙于洛南，有黎","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"264","lineNum":295,"lineType":1,"content":"陽爻，晝數也。隂爻，夜數也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"271","lineNum":301,"lineType":1,"content":"體數之策三百八十四，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"308","lineNum":339,"lineType":1,"content":"六十四分而二百五十六，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"309","lineNum":339,"lineType":1,"content":"是以一卦去其初上之爻，亦","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"310","lineNum":341,"lineType":1,"content":"二百五十六也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"312","lineNum":341,"lineType":1,"content":"故離坎為生物之主，以","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"313","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426448933733384230"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"314","lineNum":345,"lineType":1,"content":"離四陽，坎四隂，故生物者必四也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"317","lineNum":347,"lineType":1,"content":"隂陽之四","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"318","lineNum":349,"lineType":1,"content":"十共為二百五十六也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"320","lineNum":351,"lineType":1,"content":"六爻用四位，離坎主之也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"321","lineNum":351,"lineType":1,"content":"故天之昏曉不生物，而日中","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"322","lineNum":353,"lineType":1,"content":"生物；地之南北不生物，而中央生物也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"323","lineNum":355,"lineType":1,"content":"體數何為者也？生物者也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"324","lineNum":355,"lineType":1,"content":"用數何為者也？運行者也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"327","lineNum":357,"lineType":1,"content":"天以獨運，故以用數自相乘，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"333","lineNum":363,"lineType":1,"content":"為生物之數也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"334","lineNum":365,"lineType":1,"content":"天數三，故六六而义六之，是以乾之策二百一十有六。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"335","lineNum":367,"lineType":1,"content":"地數兩，故十二而十二之，是以坤之策百四十有四也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"336","lineNum":369,"lineType":1,"content":"乾用九，故三其八為二十四而九之，亦二百一十六。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"343","lineNum":375,"lineType":1,"content":"坤以十二之二十四，六之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"344","lineNum":377,"lineType":1,"content":"六之一與半為乾之餘分，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"345","lineNum":377,"lineType":1,"content":"則乾得二百五十二，坤得一","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"346","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426448920005328933"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"347","lineNum":381,"lineType":1,"content":"百八也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"348","lineNum":383,"lineType":1,"content":"體有三百八十四，而用止于三百六十，何也？","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"349","lineNum":383,"lineType":1,"content":"以乾坤離","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"350","lineNum":385,"lineType":1,"content":"坎之不用也。乾坤離坎之不用，何也？","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"351","lineNum":385,"lineType":1,"content":"乾坤離坎之不用，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"352","lineNum":387,"lineType":1,"content":"所以成三百六十之用也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"353","lineNum":387,"lineType":1,"content":"故萬物變易而四者不變也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"354","lineNum":389,"lineType":1,"content":"夫惟不變，是以能變也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"357","lineNum":391,"lineType":1,"content":"數之嬴則何用也？乾全用也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"360","lineNum":393,"lineType":1,"content":"乾全用者，何也？陽主嬴也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"361","lineNum":393,"lineType":1,"content":"乾坤不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"362","lineNum":395,"lineType":1,"content":"用者，何也？獨陽不生，專隂不成也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"363","lineNum":395,"lineType":1,"content":"離坎用半，何也？離東","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"364","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426448909343686671"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"365","lineNum":399,"lineType":1,"content":"坎西，當隂陽之半，為春秋晝夜之門也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"366","lineNum":399,"lineType":1,"content":"或用乾，或用離","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"367","lineNum":401,"lineType":1,"content":"坎，何也？","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"368","lineNum":401,"lineType":1,"content":"主陽而言之，故用乾也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"369","lineNum":401,"lineType":1,"content":"主嬴分而言之，則陽侵","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"370","lineNum":403,"lineType":1,"content":"隂，晝侵夜，故用離坎也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"372","lineNum":403,"lineType":1,"content":"隂主虛，故","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"373","lineNum":405,"lineType":1,"content":"坤全不用也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"375","lineNum":405,"lineType":1,"content":"是以天之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"376","lineNum":407,"lineType":1,"content":"南全見，而北全不見，東西各半見也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"377","lineNum":407,"lineType":1,"content":"離坎，隂陽之限也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"378","lineNum":409,"lineType":1,"content":"故離當寅，坎當申，而數常踰之者，蓋隂陽之溢也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"379","lineNum":409,"lineType":1,"content":"然用","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"380","lineNum":411,"lineType":1,"content":"數不過乎寅，交數不過乎申也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"381","lineNum":411,"lineType":2,"content":"或離當卯，坎當酉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"382","lineNum":413,"lineType":1,"content":"乾四十八，兌三十，離二十四，震十，坤十二，艮二十，坎三","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"383","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426448893380132903"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"384","lineNum":417,"lineType":1,"content":"十六，巽四十。乾三十六，坤十二，離、兌、巽二十八，坎、艮、震","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"385","lineNum":419,"lineType":1,"content":"二十。乾四十八而四分之，一分為隂所尅。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"386","lineNum":419,"lineType":1,"content":"坤四十八而","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"387","lineNum":421,"lineType":1,"content":"四分之，一為所尅之陽也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"388","lineNum":421,"lineType":1,"content":"故乾得三十六，而坤得十二","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"389","lineNum":423,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"390","lineNum":423,"lineType":1,"content":"陽主進，是以進之為三百六十日。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"391","lineNum":423,"lineType":1,"content":"隂主消，是以十二","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"392","lineNum":425,"lineType":1,"content":"月消十二日也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"393","lineNum":427,"lineType":1,"content":"陽四卦十二爻，八陽四隂，以三十六乘其陽，以二十四","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"394","lineNum":429,"lineType":1,"content":"乘其隂，則三百八十四也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"395","lineNum":431,"lineType":1,"content":"圓者，星也。厯紀之數，其肇於此乎？方者，土也。畫州井地","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"396","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426448893380116519"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"397","lineNum":435,"lineType":1,"content":"之法，其仿於此乎？蓋圓者，河圖之數；方者，洛書之文。故","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"398","lineNum":437,"lineType":1,"content":"犧、文因之而造易，禹、箕敍之而作範也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"399","lineNum":439,"lineType":1,"content":"圓數有一，方數有二，奇偶之義也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"400","lineNum":439,"lineType":1,"content":"六即一也，十二即二","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"401","lineNum":441,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"402","lineNum":443,"lineType":1,"content":"圓者徑一圍三，重之則六。方者徑一圍四，重之則八也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"403","lineNum":445,"lineType":1,"content":"天圓而地方，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"436","lineNum":477,"lineType":1,"content":"方者分一而為四，分四而為十六，皆自然之道","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"437","lineNum":479,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"438","lineNum":481,"lineType":1,"content":"圓者一變則生六，去一則五也；二變則生十二，去二則","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"439","lineNum":483,"lineType":1,"content":"十也；三變則生十八，去三則十五也；四變則二十四，去","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"440","lineNum":485,"lineType":1,"content":"四則二十也。五變則三十，去五，則二十五也。六變則三","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"441","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426448885746483209"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"442","lineNum":489,"lineType":1,"content":"十六，去六，則三十也。是以存之則六六，去之則五五也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"443","lineNum":491,"lineType":1,"content":"五則四而存一也；四則三而存一也；二則一而存一也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"444","lineNum":493,"lineType":1,"content":"故一生二，去一則一也。二生三，去一則二也。三生四，去","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"445","lineNum":495,"lineType":1,"content":"一則三也。四生五，去一，則四也。是故二以一為本，三以","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"446","lineNum":497,"lineType":1,"content":"二為本，四以三為本，五以四為本，六以五為本。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"447","lineNum":497,"lineType":2,"content":"更思之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"448","lineNum":499,"lineType":1,"content":"方者，一變而為四，四生八，幷四而為十二。八生十二，幷","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"449","lineNum":501,"lineType":1,"content":"八而為二十。十二生十六，幷十二而為二十八。十六生","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"450","lineNum":503,"lineType":1,"content":"二十，并十六而為三十六也。一生三，并而為四也。十二","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"451","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426448882890195007"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"452","lineNum":507,"lineType":1,"content":"生二十，幷而為三十二也。二十八生三十六，幷而為六","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"453","lineNum":509,"lineType":1,"content":"十四也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"454","lineNum":509,"lineType":2,"content":"更思之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"455","lineNum":511,"lineType":1,"content":"一役二，以生三，三去其一，則二也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"520","lineNum":573,"lineType":1,"content":"體以用為本，故去四也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"521","lineNum":573,"lineType":1,"content":"圓者本一，方者本四，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"522","lineNum":575,"lineType":1,"content":"故蓍存一而卦去四也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"523","lineNum":575,"lineType":1,"content":"蓍之用數七，幷其餘分，亦存一","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"524","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426448912967303231"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"525","lineNum":579,"lineType":1,"content":"之義也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"526","lineNum":579,"lineType":1,"content":"掛其一，亦去一之義也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"527","lineNum":581,"lineType":1,"content":"蓍數不以六而以七，何也？幷其餘分也。去其餘分則六，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"528","lineNum":583,"lineType":1,"content":"故策數三十六也。是以五十者，六十四卦閏歲之策也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"529","lineNum":585,"lineType":1,"content":"其用四十有九，六十四卦一歲之策也。歸奇掛一，猶一","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"530","lineNum":587,"lineType":1,"content":"歲之閏也。卦直去四者，何也？天變而地效之，是以蓍去","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"531","lineNum":589,"lineType":1,"content":"一則卦去四也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"532","lineNum":591,"lineType":1,"content":"蓍之用數，掛一以象三，其餘四十八，則一卦之策也。四","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"533","lineNum":593,"lineType":1,"content":"其十二，為四十八也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"534","lineNum":593,"lineType":1,"content":"十二去三而用九，四三十二，所去","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"535","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426448912958898239"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"536","lineNum":597,"lineType":1,"content":"之策也，四九三十六，所用之策也，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"537","lineNum":597,"lineType":1,"content":"以當乾之三十六陽","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"538","lineNum":599,"lineType":1,"content":"爻也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"539","lineNum":599,"lineType":1,"content":"十二去五而用七，四五二十，所去之策也，四七二","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"540","lineNum":601,"lineType":1,"content":"十八，所用之策也，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"541","lineNum":601,"lineType":1,"content":"以當兌、離之二十八陽爻也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"542","lineNum":601,"lineType":1,"content":"十二去","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"543","lineNum":603,"lineType":1,"content":"六而用六，四六二十四，所去之策也，四六二十四，所用","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"544","lineNum":605,"lineType":1,"content":"之策也，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"545","lineNum":605,"lineType":1,"content":"以當坤之二十四隂爻也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"546","lineNum":605,"lineType":1,"content":"十二去四而用八，四","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"547","lineNum":607,"lineType":1,"content":"四十六，所去之策也，四八三十二，所用之策也，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"548","lineNum":607,"lineType":1,"content":"以當艮、","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"549","lineNum":609,"lineType":1,"content":"坎之二十四爻，幷上卦之八隂為三十二爻也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"550","lineNum":609,"lineType":1,"content":"是故七、","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"551","lineNum":611,"lineType":1,"content":"九為陽，六、八為隂也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"552","lineNum":611,"lineType":1,"content":"九者陽之極數，六者隂之極數，數","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"553","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426448919875502121"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"554","lineNum":615,"lineType":1,"content":"極則反，故為卦之變也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"555","lineNum":615,"lineType":1,"content":"震、巽無策者，以當不用之數。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"556","lineNum":615,"lineType":1,"content":"天","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"557","lineNum":617,"lineType":1,"content":"以剛為徳，故柔者不見。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"558","lineNum":617,"lineType":1,"content":"地以柔為體，故剛者不生。是以","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"559","lineNum":619,"lineType":1,"content":"震巽無策也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"560","lineNum":619,"lineType":2,"content":"或先艮後兌、離。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"561","lineNum":619,"lineType":1,"content":"乾用九，故其策九也。四之者，以應","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"562","lineNum":621,"lineType":1,"content":"四時，一時九十日也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"563","lineNum":621,"lineType":1,"content":"坤用六，故其策亦六也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"564","lineNum":623,"lineType":1,"content":"竒數四，有一，有二，有三，有四；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"565","lineNum":623,"lineType":1,"content":"策數四，有六，有七，有八，有","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"566","lineNum":625,"lineType":1,"content":"九。合而為八數，以應方數之八變也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"567","lineNum":627,"lineType":1,"content":"歸奇合掛之數有六，謂五與四四也，九與八八也，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"568","lineNum":627,"lineType":1,"content":"五與","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"569","lineNum":629,"lineType":1,"content":"四八也，九與四八也，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"570","lineNum":629,"lineType":1,"content":"五與八八也，九與四四也，以應圓","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"571","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426448920005361701"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"572","lineNum":633,"lineType":1,"content":"數之變六也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"573","lineNum":635,"lineType":1,"content":"奇數極於四而五不用，策數極於九而十不用。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"574","lineNum":635,"lineType":1,"content":"五則一","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"575","lineNum":637,"lineType":1,"content":"也，十則二也，故去五十而用四十九也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"576","lineNum":637,"lineType":1,"content":"奇不用五，策不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"577","lineNum":639,"lineType":1,"content":"用十，有無之極也，以况自然之數也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"578","lineNum":641,"lineType":1,"content":"蓍數全，故陽策三十六與二十八合之為六十四也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"579","lineNum":641,"lineType":1,"content":"卦","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"580","lineNum":643,"lineType":1,"content":"數去其四，故隂策二十四與三十二合之為五十六也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"581","lineNum":645,"lineType":1,"content":"九進之為三十六，皆陽數也，故為陽中之陽。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"582","lineNum":645,"lineType":1,"content":"七進之為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"583","lineNum":647,"lineType":1,"content":"二十八，先陽而後隂也，故為陽中之隂。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"584","lineNum":647,"lineType":1,"content":"六進之為二十","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"585","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426448925269196800"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"586","lineNum":651,"lineType":1,"content":"四，皆隂數也，故為隂中之隂。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"587","lineNum":651,"lineType":1,"content":"八進之為三十二，先隂而","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"588","lineNum":653,"lineType":1,"content":"後陽也，故為隂中之陽。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"589","lineNum":655,"lineType":1,"content":"蓍四進之則百，卦四進之則百二十。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"590","lineNum":655,"lineType":1,"content":"百則十也，百二十","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"591","lineNum":657,"lineType":1,"content":"則十二也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"592","lineNum":659,"lineType":1,"content":"歸竒合掛之數，得五與四四，則策數四九也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"593","lineNum":659,"lineType":1,"content":"得九與八","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"594","lineNum":661,"lineType":1,"content":"八，則策數四六也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"595","lineNum":661,"lineType":1,"content":"得五與八八、得九與四八，則策數皆","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"596","lineNum":663,"lineType":1,"content":"四七也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"597","lineNum":663,"lineType":1,"content":"得九與四四、得五與四八，則策數皆四八也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"604","lineNum":669,"lineType":1,"content":"為八者，二變以應艮與坎也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"605","lineNum":669,"lineType":1,"content":"五與四","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"606","lineNum":671,"lineType":1,"content":"四，去掛一之數，則四八三十二也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"607","lineNum":671,"lineType":1,"content":"九與八八，去掛一之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"608","lineNum":673,"lineType":1,"content":"數，則四六二十四也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"609","lineNum":673,"lineType":1,"content":"五與八八、九與四八，去掛一之數，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"610","lineNum":675,"lineType":1,"content":"則四五二十也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"613","lineNum":677,"lineType":1,"content":"故去其三、四、五、六之數，以成九、八、七、六之策","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"614","lineNum":679,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"615","lineNum":681,"lineType":1,"content":"天一地二，天三地四，天五地六，天七地八，天九地十。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"619","lineNum":683,"lineType":1,"content":"一","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"620","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426448923998339081"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"621","lineNum":687,"lineType":1,"content":"者，數之始，而非數也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"622","lineNum":687,"lineType":1,"content":"故二二為四，三三為九，四四為十","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"623","lineNum":689,"lineType":1,"content":"六，五五為二十五，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"626","lineNum":691,"lineType":1,"content":"百則十也，十","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"627","lineNum":693,"lineType":1,"content":"則一也，亦不可變也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"628","lineNum":693,"lineType":1,"content":"是故數去其一而極于九，皆用其","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"629","lineNum":695,"lineType":1,"content":"變者也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"633","lineNum":697,"lineType":1,"content":"八八六十四，卦數也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"634","lineNum":697,"lineType":1,"content":"九九","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"635","lineNum":699,"lineType":1,"content":"八十一，𤣥範之數也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"636","lineNum":701,"lineType":1,"content":"大衍之數，其算法之源乎？","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"637","lineNum":701,"lineType":1,"content":"是以算數之起，不過乎方圓","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"638","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426448919875534889"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"639","lineNum":705,"lineType":1,"content":"曲直也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"640","lineNum":705,"lineType":1,"content":"乘數，生數也。除數，消數也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"641","lineNum":705,"lineType":1,"content":"算法雖多，不出乎此","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"642","lineNum":707,"lineType":1,"content":"矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"643","lineNum":709,"lineType":1,"content":"易之大衍，何數也？聖人之𠋣數也。天數二十五，合之為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"644","lineNum":711,"lineType":1,"content":"五十。地數三十，合之為六十。故曰五位相得而各有合","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"645","lineNum":713,"lineType":1,"content":"也。五十者，蓍之數也。六十者，卦之數也。五者，蓍之小衍","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"646","lineNum":715,"lineType":1,"content":"也，故五十為大衍也。八者，卦之小成，則六十四為大成","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"647","lineNum":717,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"648","lineNum":719,"lineType":1,"content":"五十分之則為十，若三天兩之則為六，兩地又兩之則","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"649","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426448906172743714"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"650","lineNum":723,"lineType":1,"content":"為四，此天地分太極之數也。天之變六，六其六得三十","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"651","lineNum":725,"lineType":1,"content":"六，為乾一爻之數也。積六爻之策，共得二百一十有六，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"652","lineNum":727,"lineType":1,"content":"為乾之策；六其四，得二十四，為坤一爻之策。積六爻之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"653","lineNum":729,"lineType":1,"content":"數，共得一百四十有四，為坤之策。積二篇之策，乃萬有","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"654","lineNum":731,"lineType":1,"content":"一千五百二十也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"655","lineNum":733,"lineType":1,"content":"陽得隂而生，隂得陽而成，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"656","lineNum":733,"lineType":1,"content":"故蓍數四而九，卦數六而十","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"657","lineNum":735,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"658","lineNum":735,"lineType":1,"content":"猶幹支之相錯，幹以六終，而支以五終也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"659","lineNum":737,"lineType":1,"content":"卦有六十四，而用止六十者，何也？六十卦者，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"660","lineNum":737,"lineType":1,"content":"三百六十","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"661","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426448912958914623"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"662","lineNum":741,"lineType":1,"content":"爻也，故甲子止于六十也。六甲天道窮矣，是以策數應","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"663","lineNum":743,"lineType":1,"content":"之，三十六與二十四，合之則六十也。三十二與二十八，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"664","lineNum":745,"lineType":1,"content":"合之亦六十也。乾四十八，坤十二，震二十，巽四十，離、兌","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"665","lineNum":747,"lineType":1,"content":"三十二，坎、艮二十八，合之亦六十也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"666","lineNum":749,"lineType":1,"content":"三四十二也，二六亦十二也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"667","lineNum":749,"lineType":1,"content":"二其十二，二十四也，三八","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"668","lineNum":751,"lineType":1,"content":"亦二十四也，四六亦二十四也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"669","lineNum":751,"lineType":1,"content":"三其十二，三十六也，四","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"670","lineNum":753,"lineType":1,"content":"九亦三十六也，六六亦三十六也；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"671","lineNum":753,"lineType":1,"content":"四其十二，四十八也；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"672","lineNum":755,"lineType":1,"content":"三其十六亦四十八也，六八亦四十八也；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"673","lineNum":755,"lineType":1,"content":"五其十二，六","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"674","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426448912967319615"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"675","lineNum":759,"lineType":1,"content":"十也；三其二十亦六十也；六其十亦六十也。皆自然之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"676","lineNum":761,"lineType":1,"content":"相符也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"677","lineNum":761,"lineType":2,"content":"此蓋隂數分其陽數耳，是以相因也。如月初一分作十二也，二十","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"678","lineNum":761,"lineType":2,"content":"四氣、七十二候之數，亦可因","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"679","lineNum":763,"lineType":2,"content":"以明之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"680","lineNum":765,"lineType":1,"content":"四九三十六也，六六三十六也，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"681","lineNum":765,"lineType":1,"content":"陽六而乂，兼隂六之半，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"682","lineNum":767,"lineType":1,"content":"是以九也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"683","lineNum":767,"lineType":1,"content":"故以二卦言之，隂陽各三也；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"684","lineNum":767,"lineType":1,"content":"以三爻言之，天","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"685","lineNum":769,"lineType":1,"content":"地人各二也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"686","lineNum":769,"lineType":1,"content":"隂陽之中各有天地人，天地人之中各有","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"687","lineNum":771,"lineType":1,"content":"隂陽，故參天兩地而倚數也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"688","lineNum":773,"lineType":1,"content":"易有真數，三而已。參天者，三三而九；兩地者，倍三而六。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"689","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426448909515522100"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"690","lineNum":777,"lineType":1,"content":"參天兩地而倚數，非天地之正數也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"691","lineNum":777,"lineType":1,"content":"𠋣者，擬也，擬天地","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"692","lineNum":779,"lineType":1,"content":"正數而生也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
