{"lines":[{"lineId":"693","lineNum":781,"lineType":1,"content":"易之數窮天地終始。或曰：天地亦有終始乎？曰：既有消","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"694","lineNum":783,"lineType":1,"content":"長，豈無終始？天地雖大，是亦形器，乃二物也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"695","lineNum":785,"lineType":1,"content":"易之生數一十二萬九千六百，總為四千三百二十，比","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"696","lineNum":787,"lineType":1,"content":"消長之大數，演三十年之辰數，卽其數也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"697","lineNum":787,"lineType":1,"content":"歲三百六十","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"698","lineNum":789,"lineType":1,"content":"日，得四千三百二十辰，以三十乘之，得其數矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"699","lineNum":789,"lineType":1,"content":"凡甲子、","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"700","lineNum":791,"lineType":1,"content":"甲午為世首，此為經世之數，始于日甲、月子、星甲、辰子。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"701","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426448912958931007"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"702","lineNum":795,"lineType":1,"content":"又云：此經世日甲之數，月子、星甲、辰子從之也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"703","lineNum":797,"lineType":1,"content":"十、百、千、萬、億為奇，天之數也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"704","lineNum":797,"lineType":1,"content":"十二、百二十、千二百、萬二","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"705","lineNum":799,"lineType":1,"content":"千、億二萬為偶，地之數也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"706","lineNum":801,"lineType":1,"content":"十干，天也；十二支，地也。支干配天地之用也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"707","lineNum":803,"lineType":1,"content":"干者，幹之義，陽也；支者，枝之義，隂也。干十而支十二，是","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"708","lineNum":805,"lineType":1,"content":"陽數中有隂，隂數中有陽也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"709","lineNum":807,"lineType":1,"content":"陽數一，衍之為十，十干之類是也。隂數二，衍之為十二，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"710","lineNum":809,"lineType":1,"content":"十二支、","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"711","lineNum":809,"lineType":1,"content":"十二月之類是也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"712","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426448909515538484"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"713","lineNum":813,"lineType":1,"content":"陽無十，故不足于後；隂無一，故不足于首。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"714","lineNum":815,"lineType":1,"content":"陽數於三百六十上盈，隂數於三百六十上縮。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"715","lineNum":817,"lineType":1,"content":"體四而變六，兼神與氣也。氣變必有，故三百六十也。氣","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"716","lineNum":819,"lineType":1,"content":"以六變，體以四分。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"717","lineNum":821,"lineType":1,"content":"天地之交十之三，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"718","lineNum":823,"lineType":1,"content":"凡事為之極幾十之七，則可以正矣。蓋夏至之日止于","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"719","lineNum":825,"lineType":1,"content":"六十，兼之以晨昏分，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"720","lineNum":825,"lineType":2,"content":"可辨邑矣，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"721","lineNum":825,"lineType":1,"content":"庶幾乎十之七也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"722","lineNum":827,"lineType":1,"content":"正音律。數行至于七而止者，以夏至之日出於寅而入","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"723","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426448933733416998"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"724","lineNum":831,"lineType":1,"content":"於戌，亥、子、丑三時，則日入於地而目無所見。此三數不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"725","lineNum":833,"lineType":1,"content":"行者，所以比於三時也。故生物之數亦然，非數之不行","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"726","lineNum":835,"lineType":1,"content":"也，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"727","lineNum":835,"lineType":1,"content":"有數而不見也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"728","lineNum":837,"lineType":1,"content":"天下之數出於理，違乎理則入於術。世人以數而入術，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"729","lineNum":839,"lineType":1,"content":"故失於理也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"730","lineNum":841,"lineType":1,"content":"太極既分，兩儀立矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"731","lineNum":841,"lineType":1,"content":"陽下交於隂，隂上交於陽，四象生","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"732","lineNum":843,"lineType":1,"content":"矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"733","lineNum":843,"lineType":1,"content":"陽交於隂，隂交於陽，而生天之四象；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"734","lineNum":843,"lineType":1,"content":"剛交於柔，柔交","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"735","lineNum":845,"lineType":1,"content":"於剛，而生地之四象。於是八卦成矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"736","lineNum":845,"lineType":1,"content":"八卦相錯，然後萬","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"737","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426448912958947391"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"738","lineNum":849,"lineType":1,"content":"物生焉。是故一分為二，二分為四，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"739","lineNum":849,"lineType":1,"content":"四分為八，八分為十","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"740","lineNum":851,"lineType":1,"content":"六，十六分為三十二，三十二分為六十四。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"741","lineNum":851,"lineType":1,"content":"故曰分隂分","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"742","lineNum":853,"lineType":1,"content":"陽，迭用柔剛，易六位而成章也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"743","lineNum":853,"lineType":1,"content":"十分為百，百分為千，千","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"744","lineNum":855,"lineType":1,"content":"分為萬，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"745","lineNum":855,"lineType":1,"content":"猶根之有幹，幹之有枝，枝之有葉，愈大則愈少，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"746","lineNum":857,"lineType":1,"content":"愈細則愈繁，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"747","lineNum":857,"lineType":1,"content":"合之斯為一，衍之斯為萬。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"748","lineNum":857,"lineType":1,"content":"是故乾以分之，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"749","lineNum":859,"lineType":1,"content":"坤以翕之，震以長之，巽以消之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"750","lineNum":859,"lineType":1,"content":"長則分，分則消，消則翕","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"751","lineNum":861,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"752","lineNum":861,"lineType":1,"content":"乾坤定位也，震巽一交也，兌離坎艮再交也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"753","lineNum":861,"lineType":1,"content":"故震陽","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"754","lineNum":863,"lineType":1,"content":"少而隂尚多也，巽隂少而陽尚多也，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"755","lineNum":863,"lineType":1,"content":"兌離陽浸多也，坎","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"756","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426448906172760098"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"757","lineNum":867,"lineType":1,"content":"艮隂浸多也。是以辰與火不見也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"758","lineNum":869,"lineType":1,"content":"一氣分而隂陽判，得陽之多者為天，得隂之多者為地。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"759","lineNum":871,"lineType":1,"content":"是故隂陽半而形質具焉，隂陽偏而性情分焉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"760","lineNum":871,"lineType":1,"content":"形質又","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"761","lineNum":873,"lineType":1,"content":"分，則多陽者為剛也，多隂者為柔也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"762","lineNum":873,"lineType":1,"content":"性情又分，則多陽","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"763","lineNum":875,"lineType":1,"content":"者陽之極也，多隂者隂之極也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"764","lineNum":875,"lineType":1,"content":"兌離巽得陽之多者也，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"765","lineNum":877,"lineType":1,"content":"艮坎震得隂之多者也。是以為天地用也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"766","lineNum":877,"lineType":1,"content":"乾陽極，坤隂","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"767","lineNum":879,"lineType":1,"content":"極，是以不用也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"768","lineNum":881,"lineType":1,"content":"乾坤之名位不可易也，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"769","lineNum":881,"lineType":1,"content":"坎離名可易而位不可易也，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"770","lineNum":881,"lineType":1,"content":"震","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"771","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426448909515489332"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"772","lineNum":885,"lineType":1,"content":"巽位可易而名不可易也，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"773","lineNum":885,"lineType":1,"content":"兌艮名與位皆可易也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"774","lineNum":885,"lineType":1,"content":"離肖","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"775","lineNum":887,"lineType":1,"content":"乾，坎肖坤，中孚肖乾，頤肖離，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"776","lineNum":887,"lineType":1,"content":"小過肖坤，大過肖坎，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"777","lineNum":887,"lineType":1,"content":"是以","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"778","lineNum":889,"lineType":1,"content":"乾、坤、離、坎、中孚、頤、大過、小過皆不可易者也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"779","lineNum":889,"lineType":1,"content":"離在天而","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"780","lineNum":891,"lineType":1,"content":"當夜，故陽中有隂也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"781","lineNum":891,"lineType":1,"content":"坎在地而當晝，故隂中有陽也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"782","lineNum":891,"lineType":1,"content":"震","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"783","lineNum":893,"lineType":1,"content":"始交隂而陽生，巽始消陽而隂生。兌陽長也，艮隂長也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"784","lineNum":895,"lineType":1,"content":"震兌在天之隂也，巽艮在地之陽也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"785","lineNum":895,"lineType":1,"content":"故震兌上隂而下","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"786","lineNum":897,"lineType":1,"content":"陽，巽艮上陽而下隂。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"787","lineNum":897,"lineType":1,"content":"天以始生言之，故隂上而陽下，交","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"788","lineNum":899,"lineType":1,"content":"泰之義也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"789","lineNum":899,"lineType":1,"content":"地以既成言之，故陽上而隂下，尊卑之位也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"790","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426448923998322697"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"791","lineNum":903,"lineType":1,"content":"乾坤定上下之位，離坎列左右之門，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"792","lineNum":903,"lineType":1,"content":"天地之所闔闢，日","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"793","lineNum":905,"lineType":1,"content":"月之所出入。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"794","lineNum":905,"lineType":1,"content":"是以春夏秋冬、晦朔弦望、晝夜長短、行度","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"795","lineNum":907,"lineType":1,"content":"盈縮，莫不由乎此矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"796","lineNum":909,"lineType":1,"content":"乾四分取一以與坤，坤四分取一以奉乾，乾坤合而生","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"797","lineNum":911,"lineType":1,"content":"六子，三男皆陽也，三女皆隂也。兌分一陽以與艮，坎分","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"798","lineNum":913,"lineType":1,"content":"一隂以奉離，震巽以二相易，合而言之，隂陽各半，是以","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"799","lineNum":915,"lineType":1,"content":"水火相生而相尅，然後既成萬物也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"800","lineNum":917,"lineType":1,"content":"乾坤縱而六子横，易之本也。震兌横而六卦縱，易之用","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"801","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426448909515505716"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"802","lineNum":921,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"803","lineNum":923,"lineType":1,"content":"起震終艮一節，明文王八卦也。天地定位一節，明伏羲","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"804","lineNum":925,"lineType":1,"content":"八卦也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"805","lineNum":927,"lineType":1,"content":"八卦相錯者，相交錯而成六十四卦也。數往者順，若順","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"806","lineNum":929,"lineType":1,"content":"天而行，是左旋也，皆己生之卦也，故云數往也。知來者","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"807","lineNum":931,"lineType":1,"content":"逆，若逆天而行，是右行也，皆未生之卦也，故云知來也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"808","lineNum":933,"lineType":1,"content":"夫易之數，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"809","lineNum":933,"lineType":1,"content":"由逆而成矣。此一節直解圖意，若逆知四時","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"810","lineNum":935,"lineType":1,"content":"之謂也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"811","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426448919875518505"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"812","lineNum":939,"lineType":1,"content":"陽在隂中，陽逆行；隂在陽中，隂逆行；陽在陽中，隂在隂","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"813","lineNum":941,"lineType":1,"content":"中，則皆順行。此真至理，按圖可見之矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"814","lineNum":943,"lineType":1,"content":"順數之，乾一、兌二、離三、震四，巽五、坎六、艮七、坤八；逆數","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"815","lineNum":945,"lineType":1,"content":"之，震一，離兌二，乾三，巽四，坎五，艮坤六也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"816","lineNum":947,"lineType":1,"content":"四正者，乾坤坎離也。觀其象無反覆之變，所以為正也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"817","lineNum":949,"lineType":1,"content":"卦之反對，皆六陽六隂也。在易則六陽六隂者，十有一","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"818","lineNum":951,"lineType":1,"content":"對也。去四正者，八陽四隂、八隂四陽者，各六對也。十陽","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"819","lineNum":953,"lineType":1,"content":"二隂、十隂二陽者，各三對也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"820","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426448923998306313"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"821","lineNum":957,"lineType":1,"content":"復至乾凡百有十二陽，姤至坤凡八十陽。姤至坤凡百","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"822","lineNum":959,"lineType":1,"content":"有十二隂，復至乾凡八十隂。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"823","lineNum":961,"lineType":1,"content":"夫易根于乾、坤而生于姤、復，蓋剛交柔而為復，柔交剛","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"824","lineNum":963,"lineType":1,"content":"而為姤，自兹而無窮矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"825","lineNum":965,"lineType":1,"content":"無極之前，隂含陽也；有象之後，陽分隂也。隂為陽之母，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"826","lineNum":967,"lineType":1,"content":"陽為隂之父，故母孕長男而為復，父生長女而為姤。是","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"827","lineNum":969,"lineType":1,"content":"以陽起於復，而隂起於姤也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"828","lineNum":971,"lineType":1,"content":"諸卦不交於乾、坤者，則生於否、泰。否、泰，乾、坤之交也。乾、","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"829","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7619018243772989482"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"830","lineNum":975,"lineType":1,"content":"坤起自奇耦，生自太極。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"831","lineNum":977,"lineType":1,"content":"自泰至否，其間則有蠱矣；自否至泰，其間則有隨矣。一","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"832","lineNum":979,"lineType":1,"content":"變而二，二變而四，三變而八卦成矣。四變而有十六，五","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"833","lineNum":981,"lineType":1,"content":"變而三十有二，六變而六十四卦備矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"834","lineNum":983,"lineType":1,"content":"至哉！文王之作易也，其得天地之用乎？故乾、坤交而為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"835","lineNum":985,"lineType":1,"content":"泰，坎、離交而為既濟也。乾生于子，坤生於午，坎終於寅，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"836","lineNum":987,"lineType":1,"content":"離終於申，以應天之時也。置乾於西北，退坤於西南，長","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"837","lineNum":989,"lineType":1,"content":"子用事而長女代母，坎離得位，兌艮為耦，以應地之方","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"838","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7619018243773005866"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"839","lineNum":993,"lineType":1,"content":"也。王者之法，其盡於是矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"840","lineNum":995,"lineType":1,"content":"易者，一隂一陽之謂也。震兌，始交者也，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"841","lineNum":995,"lineType":1,"content":"故當朝夕之位；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"842","lineNum":997,"lineType":1,"content":"離坎，交之極也，故當子午位；巽、艮雖不交，而隂陽猶雜","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"843","lineNum":999,"lineType":1,"content":"也，故當用中之偏位；乾、坤，純隂陽也，故當不用之位。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"844","lineNum":1001,"lineType":1,"content":"坤純三女於西南，乾純三男於東北。道生天，天生地，及","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"845","lineNum":1003,"lineType":1,"content":"其功成而身退，故子繼父禪，是以乾退一位也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"846","lineNum":1005,"lineType":1,"content":"易之首于乾、坤，中于坎、離，終于水火之交不交，皆至理","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"847","lineNum":1007,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"848","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7619018243773022250"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"849","lineNum":1011,"lineType":1,"content":"自乾坤至坎離，以天道也；自咸恒至既濟、未濟，以人事","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"850","lineNum":1013,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"851","lineNum":1015,"lineType":1,"content":"乾、坤交而為泰，變而為雜卦也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"852","lineNum":1017,"lineType":1,"content":"上經起於三，下經起於四，皆交泰之義也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"853","lineNum":1019,"lineType":1,"content":"乾坤、坎離為上篇之用，兌艮震巽為下篇之用也。頤、中","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"854","lineNum":1021,"lineType":1,"content":"孚、大過小過為二篇之正也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"855","lineNum":1023,"lineType":1,"content":"乾坤，天地之本；坎、離，天地之用。是以易始於乾坤，中於","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"856","lineNum":1025,"lineType":1,"content":"坎離，終於既未濟，而泰否為上經之中，咸恒為下經之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"857","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7619018243773038634"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"858","lineNum":1029,"lineType":1,"content":"首，皆言乎其用也。故易者，用也。乾用九，坤用六，大衍用","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"859","lineNum":1031,"lineType":1,"content":"四十九，而潛龍勿用也。大哉用乎！吾於此見聖人之心","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"860","lineNum":1033,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"861","lineNum":1035,"lineType":1,"content":"夫卦各有性有體，然皆不離乾坤之門，如萬物受性于","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"862","lineNum":1037,"lineType":1,"content":"天，而各為其性也。在人則為人之性，在禽獸則為禽獸","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"863","lineNum":1039,"lineType":1,"content":"之性，在草木則為草木之性。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"864","lineNum":1041,"lineType":1,"content":"不知乾，無以知性命之理。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"865","lineNum":1043,"lineType":1,"content":"在人則乾道成男，坤道成女；在物則乾道成陽，坤道成","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"866","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7619018243773055018"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"867","lineNum":1047,"lineType":1,"content":"隂。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"868","lineNum":1049,"lineType":1,"content":"君子於易，玩象，玩數，玩辭，玩意。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"869","lineNum":1051,"lineType":1,"content":"象起於形，數起於質，名起於言，意起於用。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"870","lineNum":1053,"lineType":1,"content":"有意必有言，有言必有象，有象必有數。數立則象生，象","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"871","lineNum":1055,"lineType":1,"content":"生則言彰，言彰則意顯。象數，則筌蹄也；言意，則魚兎也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"872","lineNum":1057,"lineType":1,"content":"得魚兎而忘筌蹄，則可也，捨筌蹄而求魚兎，則未見其","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"873","lineNum":1059,"lineType":1,"content":"得也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"874","lineNum":1061,"lineType":1,"content":"易為意象立意皆所以明象。統下三者，有言象，不擬物","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"875","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7619018243773071402"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"876","lineNum":1065,"lineType":1,"content":"而直言以明事；有象象擬一物以明意；有數象，七日、八","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"877","lineNum":1067,"lineType":1,"content":"月、三年、十年之類是也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"878","lineNum":1069,"lineType":1,"content":"易有內象，理致是也；有外象，指定一物而不變者是也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"879","lineNum":1071,"lineType":1,"content":"自然而然，不得而更者，內象、內數也。他皆外象、外數也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"880","lineNum":1073,"lineType":1,"content":"乾為天之類，本象也；為金之類，别象也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"881","lineNum":1075,"lineType":1,"content":"乾，奇也，陽也，健也，故天下之健莫如天。坤，耦也，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"882","lineNum":1075,"lineType":1,"content":"隂也，順","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"883","lineNum":1077,"lineType":1,"content":"也，故天下之順莫如地，所以順天也。震，起也，一陽起也，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"884","lineNum":1079,"lineType":1,"content":"起，動也，故天下之動莫如雷。坎，陷也，一陽陷於二隂，陷，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"885","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7619018243773087786"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"886","lineNum":1083,"lineType":1,"content":"下也，故天下之下莫如水。艮，止也，一陽於是而止也，故","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"887","lineNum":1085,"lineType":1,"content":"天下之止莫如山。巽，入也，一隂入二陽之下，故天下之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"888","lineNum":1087,"lineType":1,"content":"入莫如風。離，麗也，一隂離於二陽，其卦錯然成文而華","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"889","lineNum":1089,"lineType":1,"content":"麗也，故天下之麗莫如火，故又為附麗之麗。兌，說也，一","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"890","lineNum":1091,"lineType":1,"content":"隂出於外而說於物，故天下之說莫如澤。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"891","lineNum":1093,"lineType":1,"content":"火內暗而外明，故離陽在外，火之用，用外也。水外暗而","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"892","lineNum":1095,"lineType":1,"content":"內明，故坎陽在內，水之用，用內也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"893","lineNum":1097,"lineType":1,"content":"震為龍，一陽動於二隂之下，震也。重淵之下有動物者，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"894","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7619018243773104170"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"895","lineNum":1101,"lineType":1,"content":"豈非龍乎？","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"896","lineNum":1103,"lineType":1,"content":"兌，說也，其他說皆有所害，惟朋友講習無說於此，故言","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"897","lineNum":1105,"lineType":1,"content":"其極者。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"898","lineNum":1107,"lineType":1,"content":"以尊降卑曰臨，以上觀下曰觀。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"899","lineNum":1109,"lineType":1,"content":"復次剝，明治生於亂乎？姤次夬，明亂生於治乎。時哉時","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"900","lineNum":1111,"lineType":1,"content":"哉，未有剝而不復，未有夬而不姤者。防乎其防，邦家其","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"901","lineNum":1113,"lineType":1,"content":"長，子孫其昌。是以聖人貴未然之防，是謂易之大綱。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"902","lineNum":1115,"lineType":1,"content":"寂然不動，反本復靜，坤之時也。感而遂通天下之故，陽","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"903","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7619018243773120554"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"904","lineNum":1119,"lineType":1,"content":"動于中，間不容髮，復之義也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"905","lineNum":1121,"lineType":1,"content":"不見動而動，妄也，動于否之時是也。見動而動，則為無","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"906","lineNum":1123,"lineType":1,"content":"妄。然所以有災者，陽微而無應也。有應而動，則為益矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"907","lineNum":1125,"lineType":1,"content":"大過，本末弱也。必有大徳大位，然後可救。常分有可過","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"908","lineNum":1127,"lineType":1,"content":"者，有不可過者。有大徳大位，可過者也，伊、周其人也，不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"909","lineNum":1129,"lineType":1,"content":"可懼也。有大徳無大位，不可過也，孔孟其人也，不可悶","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"910","lineNum":1131,"lineType":1,"content":"也。其位不勝徳邪？大哉位乎！待才","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"911","lineNum":1131,"lineType":2,"content":"一云時","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"912","lineNum":1131,"lineType":1,"content":"用。之宅也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"913","lineNum":1133,"lineType":1,"content":"作易者其如知乎？聖人知天地萬物之理，而一以貫之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"914","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7619018243773136938"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"915","lineNum":1137,"lineType":1,"content":"夫易者，聖人長君子、消小人之具也。及其長也，闢之於","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"916","lineNum":1139,"lineType":1,"content":"未然；及其消也，闔之於未然。一消一長，一闔一闢，渾渾","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"917","lineNum":1141,"lineType":1,"content":"然無跡，非天下之至神，其孰能與於此？","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"918","lineNum":1143,"lineType":1,"content":"神者，易之主也，所以無方。易者，神之用也，所以無體。神","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"919","lineNum":1145,"lineType":1,"content":"無方而易無體。滯於一方則不能變化，非神也；有定體","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"920","lineNum":1147,"lineType":1,"content":"則不能變通，非易也。易雖有體，體者象也，假象以見體，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"921","lineNum":1149,"lineType":1,"content":"而本無體也，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"922","lineNum":1151,"lineType":1,"content":"易無體也。曰既有典常，則是有體也，恐遂以為有體，故","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"923","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7619018243773153322"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"924","lineNum":1155,"lineType":1,"content":"曰不可為典要。既有典常，常也；不可為典要，變也。生而","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"925","lineNum":1157,"lineType":1,"content":"成，成而生，易之道也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"926","lineNum":1159,"lineType":1,"content":"元亨利貞，變易不常，天道之變也。吉㐫悔吝，變易不定，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"927","lineNum":1161,"lineType":1,"content":"人道之應也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"928","lineNum":1163,"lineType":1,"content":"天變而人效之，故元亨利貞，易之變也。人行而天應之，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"929","lineNum":1165,"lineType":1,"content":"故吉㓙悔吝，易之應也。以元亨為變，則利貞為應；以吉","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"930","lineNum":1167,"lineType":1,"content":"㓙為應，則悔吝為變。元則吉，吉則利，應之亨則㓙，㓙則","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"931","lineNum":1169,"lineType":1,"content":"應之以貞；悔則吉，吝則㓙。是以變中有應，應中有變也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"932","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7619018243773169706"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"933","lineNum":1173,"lineType":1,"content":"變中之應，天道也。故元為變則亨應之；利為變則應之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"934","lineNum":1175,"lineType":1,"content":"以貞。應中之變，人事也。故變則㓙，應則吉，變則吝，應則","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"935","lineNum":1177,"lineType":1,"content":"悔也。悔者吉之先，而吝者㓙之本，是以君子從天不從","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"936","lineNum":1179,"lineType":1,"content":"人。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"937","lineNum":1181,"lineType":1,"content":"元者，春也，仁也。春者時之始，仁者徳之長。時則未盛，而","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"938","lineNum":1183,"lineType":1,"content":"徳足以長人，故言徳而不言時。亨者，夏也，禮也。夏者時","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"939","lineNum":1185,"lineType":1,"content":"之盛，禮者徳之文。盛則必衰，而文不足救之，故言時而","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"940","lineNum":1187,"lineType":1,"content":"不言徳。故曰：大哉乾元，而上九有悔也。利者，秋也，義也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"941","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7619018243773186090"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"942","lineNum":1191,"lineType":1,"content":"秋者時之成，義者徳之方。萬物方成而獲利，義者不通","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"943","lineNum":1193,"lineType":1,"content":"於利，故言時而不言徳也。貞者，冬也，智也。冬者時之末，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"944","lineNum":1195,"lineType":1,"content":"智者徳之衰，正則吉，不正則㓙，故言徳而不言時也。故","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"945","lineNum":1197,"lineType":1,"content":"曰：利貞者，性情也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"946","lineNum":1199,"lineType":1,"content":"元亨利貞之徳各包吉㓙。悔吝之事雖行乎徳，若違于","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"947","lineNum":1201,"lineType":1,"content":"時，亦或㓙矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"948","lineNum":1203,"lineType":1,"content":"初與上同，然上之亢不及初之進也。二與五同，然二之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"949","lineNum":1205,"lineType":1,"content":"隂中不及五之陽中也。三與四同，然三處下卦之上，不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"950","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7619018243773202474"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"951","lineNum":1209,"lineType":1,"content":"若四之近君也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"952","lineNum":1211,"lineType":1,"content":"六虛者，六位也，虛以待變動之事也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"953","lineNum":1213,"lineType":1,"content":"易有三百八十四爻，眞天文也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"954","lineNum":1215,"lineType":1,"content":"圖雖無文，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"955","lineNum":1215,"lineType":2,"content":"先天圖也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"956","lineNum":1215,"lineType":1,"content":"吾終日言而未嘗離乎是，蓋天地萬物","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"957","lineNum":1217,"lineType":1,"content":"之理盡在其中矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"958","lineNum":1219,"lineType":1,"content":"先天圖者，環中也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"959","lineNum":1221,"lineType":1,"content":"先天學，心法也。故圖皆自中起，萬化萬事生乎心也。先","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"960","lineNum":1223,"lineType":1,"content":"天學主乎誠，至誠可以通神明，不誠則不可以得道。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"961","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7619018243773218858"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"962","lineNum":1227,"lineType":1,"content":"先天之學，心也；後天之學，迹也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"963","lineNum":1229,"lineType":1,"content":"堯之前，先天也；堯之後，後天也。後天乃效法耳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"964","lineNum":1231,"lineType":1,"content":"易始于三皇，書始于二帝，詩始于三王，春秋始于五霸。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"965","lineNum":1233,"lineType":1,"content":"所謂皇、帝、王、霸者，非獨謂三皇五帝、三王五霸而已，但","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"966","lineNum":1235,"lineType":1,"content":"用無為則皇也，用恩信則帝也，用公正則王也，用智力","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"967","lineNum":1237,"lineType":1,"content":"則霸也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"968","lineNum":1239,"lineType":1,"content":"法始乎伏羲，成乎堯，革于三王，極于五霸，絕于秦。萬世","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"969","lineNum":1241,"lineType":1,"content":"治亂之迹，無以逃此矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"970","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7619018243773235242"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"971","lineNum":1245,"lineType":1,"content":"秦𥡆公伐鄭，敗而有悔過自誓之言，此非止霸者之事，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"972","lineNum":1247,"lineType":1,"content":"幾於王道，能悔則無過矣。此聖人所以錄於書末也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"973","lineNum":1249,"lineType":1,"content":"平王名雖王，實不及一小國之諸侯。齊、晉雖侯，而實借","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"974","lineNum":1251,"lineType":1,"content":"王。此春秋之名實也。子貢欲去吿朔之餼羊。羊，名也；禮，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"975","lineNum":1253,"lineType":1,"content":"實也。名存而實亡，猶愈於名實俱亡。茍存其名，安知後","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"976","lineNum":1255,"lineType":1,"content":"世無王者作？是以有所待也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"977","lineNum":1257,"lineType":1,"content":"秦𥡆公有功於周，能遷善改過，為霸者之最。𣈆文侯世","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"978","lineNum":1259,"lineType":1,"content":"世勤王，遷平王於洛，次之。齊桓公九合諸侯，不以兵車，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"979","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7619018243773251626"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"980","lineNum":1263,"lineType":1,"content":"又次之。楚莊强大，又次之。宋襄公雖霸而力微，㑹諸侯","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"981","lineNum":1265,"lineType":1,"content":"而為楚所執，不足論也。治春秋者，不先定四國之功過，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"982","lineNum":1267,"lineType":1,"content":"則事無統理，不得聖人之心矣。春秋之間，有功者未見","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"983","lineNum":1269,"lineType":1,"content":"大於四國者，有過者亦未見大於四國者也。故四國者，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"984","lineNum":1271,"lineType":1,"content":"功之首，罪之魁也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"985","lineNum":1273,"lineType":1,"content":"五霸者，功之首，罪之魁也。春秋者，孔子之刑書也。功過","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"986","lineNum":1275,"lineType":1,"content":"不相掩，聖人先褒其功，後貶其罪。故罪人有功者亦必","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"987","lineNum":1277,"lineType":1,"content":"錄之，不可不恕也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"988","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7619018243773268010"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"989","lineNum":1281,"lineType":1,"content":"某人受春秋於尹師魯，師魯受於𥡆伯長，某人後復攻","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"990","lineNum":1283,"lineType":1,"content":"伯長曰：春秋無褒，皆是貶也。田述古曰：孫復亦云：春秋","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"991","lineNum":1285,"lineType":1,"content":"有貶而無褒。曰：春秋禮法廢，君臣亂，其間有能為小善","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"992","lineNum":1287,"lineType":1,"content":"者，安得不進之也？况五霸實有功於天下，且五霸固不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"993","lineNum":1289,"lineType":1,"content":"及於王，不猶愈於左袵乎？安得不與之也？治春秋者不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"994","lineNum":1291,"lineType":1,"content":"辨名實，不定五霸之功過，則未可言治春秋；先定五霸","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"995","lineNum":1293,"lineType":1,"content":"之功過而治春秋，則大意立。若事事求之，則無緒也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"996","lineNum":1295,"lineType":1,"content":"春秋為君弱臣强而作，故謂之名分之書。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"997","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7619018243773284394"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"998","lineNum":1299,"lineType":1,"content":"人言春秋非性命之書，非也。至于書郊牛之口傷，改卜","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"999","lineNum":1301,"lineType":1,"content":"牛，牛死，猶三望，此因魯事而貶之也。聖人何容心哉？無","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1000","lineNum":1303,"lineType":1,"content":"我故也，豈非由性命而發言也？又云春秋皆因事而褒","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1001","lineNum":1305,"lineType":1,"content":"貶，豈聖人特立私意哉？人知春秋聖人之筆削，為天下","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1002","lineNum":1307,"lineType":1,"content":"之至公，不知聖人之所以為公也。如因牛傷，則知魯之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1003","lineNum":1309,"lineType":1,"content":"僭郊；因初獻六羽，則知舊僭八佾；因新作雉門，則知舊","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1004","lineNum":1311,"lineType":1,"content":"無雉門，皆非聖人有意於其間。故曰春秋盡性之書也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1005","lineNum":1313,"lineType":1,"content":"魯之兩觀、郊天、大禘，皆非禮也。諸侯茍有四時之禘，以","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1006","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7619018243773300778"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1007","lineNum":1317,"lineType":1,"content":"為常祭可也，至於五年大禘，不可為也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1008","lineNum":1319,"lineType":1,"content":"始作兩觀，始者，貶之也，誅其舊無也。初獻六羽，初者，褒","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1009","lineNum":1321,"lineType":1,"content":"之也，以其舊僭八佾也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1010","lineNum":1323,"lineType":1,"content":"晉狐射姑殺陽處父，春秋書晉殺其大夫陽處父，上漏","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1011","lineNum":1325,"lineType":1,"content":"言也。君不密則失臣，故書國殺。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1012","lineNum":1327,"lineType":1,"content":"夫聖人之經，渾然無跡，如天道焉。故春秋錄實事，而善","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1013","lineNum":1329,"lineType":1,"content":"惡形于其中矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1014","lineNum":1331,"lineType":1,"content":"春秋三傳之外，陸淳啖助，可以兼治。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1015","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7619018243773317162"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1016","lineNum":1335,"lineType":1,"content":"管仲用智數，晚識物理，大抵才力過人也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1017","lineNum":1337,"lineType":1,"content":"叔向、子產、晏子之才相等埒，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1018","lineNum":1339,"lineType":1,"content":"季札之才近伯夷。伯夷","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1019","lineNum":1341,"lineType":1,"content":"義不食周粟，至餓且死，止得為仁而已。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1020","lineNum":1343,"lineType":1,"content":"伯夷、柳下惠得聖人之一端。伯夷得聖人之清，柳下惠","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1021","lineNum":1345,"lineType":1,"content":"得聖人之和。孔子時清、時和，時行、時止，故得聖人之時。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1022","lineNum":1347,"lineType":1,"content":"顯諸仁，藏諸用。孟子善藏其用乎！","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1023","lineNum":1349,"lineType":1,"content":"聖人之難，在不失仁義忠信而成事業。何如則可？在於","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1024","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7619018243773333546"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1025","lineNum":1353,"lineType":1,"content":"絕四：","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1026","lineNum":1355,"lineType":1,"content":"毋意，毋必，毋固，毋我。合而言之則一，分而言之則二。合","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1027","lineNum":1357,"lineType":1,"content":"而言之則二，分而言之則四。始於有意，成於有我。有意","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1028","lineNum":1359,"lineType":1,"content":"然後有必，必生於意。有固然後有我，我生於固。意有心，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1029","lineNum":1361,"lineType":1,"content":"必有待，固不化，我有己也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1030","lineNum":1363,"lineType":1,"content":"劉絢問無為，對曰：時然後言，人不厭其言。樂然後笑，人","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1031","lineNum":1365,"lineType":1,"content":"不厭其笑。義然後取，人不厭其取。此所謂無為也。時然","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1032","lineNum":1367,"lineType":1,"content":"後言，乃應變而言，言不在我也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1033","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7619018243773349930"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1034","lineNum":1371,"lineType":1,"content":"知之為知之，不知為不知，聖人之性也。茍不知而强知","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1035","lineNum":1373,"lineType":1,"content":"之，非情而失性，而情則衆人矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1036","lineNum":1375,"lineType":1,"content":"志於道者，統而言之。志者，潛心之謂也。徳者，得於己，有","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1037","lineNum":1377,"lineType":1,"content":"形，故可據。徳主於仁，故曰依。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1038","lineNum":1379,"lineType":1,"content":"君子喻於義，賢人也。小人喻於利而己。義利兼忘者，唯","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1039","lineNum":1381,"lineType":1,"content":"聖人能之。君子畏義而有所不為，小人直不畏耳。聖人","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1040","lineNum":1383,"lineType":1,"content":"則動不踰矩，何義之畏乎？","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1041","lineNum":1385,"lineType":1,"content":"誰能出不由户？户，道也。未有不由道而能濟者也。不由","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1042","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7619018243773366314"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1043","lineNum":1389,"lineType":1,"content":"户者，開宂隙之類是也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1044","lineNum":1391,"lineType":1,"content":"多聞，擇其善者而從之。雖多聞，必擇善而從之。多見而","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1045","lineNum":1393,"lineType":1,"content":"識之。識，別也。雖多見，必有以別之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1046","lineNum":1395,"lineType":1,"content":"三人行，亦有師焉。至于友一鄉之賢，天下之賢，以天下","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1047","lineNum":1397,"lineType":1,"content":"為未足，又至於上論古人，無以加焉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1048","lineNum":1399,"lineType":1,"content":"當仁不讓於師者，進人之道也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1049","lineNum":1401,"lineType":1,"content":"有馬者借人乘之，舍己以從人也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1050","lineNum":1403,"lineType":1,"content":"或問：才難，何謂也？曰：臨大事，然後見才之難也。曰：何獨","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1051","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7619018243773382698"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1052","lineNum":1407,"lineType":1,"content":"言才？曰：才者，天之良質也。學者，所以成其才也。曰：古人","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1053","lineNum":1409,"lineType":1,"content":"有不由學問而能立功業者，何必曰學？曰：周勃、霍光能","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1054","lineNum":1411,"lineType":1,"content":"成大事，唯其無學，故未盡善也。人而無學，則不能燭理；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1055","lineNum":1413,"lineType":1,"content":"不能燭理，則固執而不通。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1056","lineNum":1415,"lineType":1,"content":"人有出人之才，必以剛克中。剛則足以立事業，處患難，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1057","lineNum":1417,"lineType":1,"content":"若用於他，反為邪惡。故孔子以申棖為焉得剛，既有慾","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1058","lineNum":1419,"lineType":1,"content":"心，必無剛也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1059","lineNum":1421,"lineType":1,"content":"仲弓可使南面，可使從政也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1060","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7619018243773399082"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1061","lineNum":1425,"lineType":1,"content":"顏子不遷怒，不貳過。遷怒、貳過，皆情也，非性也。不至於","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1062","lineNum":1427,"lineType":1,"content":"性命，不足以謂之好學。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1063","lineNum":1429,"lineType":1,"content":"顏子不貳過，孔子曰：有不善未嘗不知，知之未嘗復行","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1064","lineNum":1431,"lineType":1,"content":"是也。是一而不再也。韓愈以為將發於心，而使能絕去，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1065","lineNum":1433,"lineType":1,"content":"是過與顏子也。過與是為私意，焉能至於道哉？或曰：與","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1066","lineNum":1435,"lineType":1,"content":"善不亦愈於與惡乎？曰：聖人則不如是。私心過與，善惡","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1067","lineNum":1437,"lineType":1,"content":"同矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1068","lineNum":1439,"lineType":1,"content":"知易者不必引用講解，是為知易。孟子之言未嘗及易，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1069","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7619018243773415466"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1070","lineNum":1443,"lineType":1,"content":"其間易道存焉，俾人見之者鮮耳。人能用易，是為知易。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1071","lineNum":1445,"lineType":1,"content":"如孟子，可謂善用易者也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1072","lineNum":1447,"lineType":1,"content":"瞽瞍殺人，舜視棄天下猶棄敝屣也，竊負而逃，遵海濵","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1073","lineNum":1449,"lineType":1,"content":"而處，終身訢然，樂而忘天下。聖人雖天下之大，不能易","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1074","lineNum":1451,"lineType":1,"content":"天性之愛。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1075","lineNum":1453,"lineType":1,"content":"湯放桀，武王伐紂，而不以為弑者，若孟子言男女授受","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1076","lineNum":1455,"lineType":1,"content":"不親，禮也；嫂溺則援之以手，權也。故孔子既尊夷、齊，亦","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1077","lineNum":1457,"lineType":1,"content":"與湯、武。夷、齊，仁也；湯、武，義也。唯湯、武則可，非湯、武，是篡","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1078","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7619018243773431850"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1079","lineNum":1461,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1080","lineNum":1463,"lineType":1,"content":"中庸非天降地出，揆物之理，度人之情，行其所安，是為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1081","lineNum":1465,"lineType":1,"content":"得矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1082","lineNum":1467,"lineType":1,"content":"中庸之法，自中者，天也，自外者，人也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1083","lineNum":1469,"lineType":1,"content":"老子五千言，大抵皆明物理。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1084","lineNum":1471,"lineType":1,"content":"老子知易之體者也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1085","lineNum":1473,"lineType":1,"content":"莊子曰：庖人雖不治庖，尸祝不越樽俎而代之。此君子","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1086","lineNum":1475,"lineType":1,"content":"思不出其位，素位而行之意也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1087","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7619018243773448234"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1088","lineNum":1479,"lineType":1,"content":"莊子齊物，未免乎較量。較量則爭，爭則不平，不平則不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1089","lineNum":1481,"lineType":1,"content":"和。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1090","lineNum":1483,"lineType":1,"content":"莊子與惠子遊於濠梁之上，莊子曰：鯈魚出遊從容，是","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1091","lineNum":1485,"lineType":1,"content":"魚樂也。此盡己之性，能盡物之性也。非魚則然，天下之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1092","lineNum":1487,"lineType":1,"content":"物皆然。若莊子者，可謂善通物矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1093","lineNum":1489,"lineType":1,"content":"莊子雄辯，數千年一人而已。如庖丁解牛曰躊躇四顧，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1094","lineNum":1491,"lineType":1,"content":"孔子觀呂梁之水曰蹈水之道無私，皆至理之言也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1095","lineNum":1493,"lineType":1,"content":"莊子氣豪，若呂梁之事，言之至者也。盗跖言事之無可","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1096","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7619018243773464618"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1097","lineNum":1497,"lineType":1,"content":"奈何者，雖聖人亦莫如之何。漁父言事之不可強者，雖","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1098","lineNum":1499,"lineType":1,"content":"聖人亦不可強。此言有為無為之理，順理則無為，强則","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1099","lineNum":1501,"lineType":1,"content":"有為也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1100","lineNum":1503,"lineType":1,"content":"莊子著盜跖篇，所以明至惡雖至聖亦莫能化，蓋上智","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1101","lineNum":1505,"lineType":1,"content":"與下愚不移故也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1102","lineNum":1507,"lineType":1,"content":"魯國之儒一人者，謂孔子也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1103","lineNum":1509,"lineType":1,"content":"莊、荀之徒失之辯。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1104","lineNum":1511,"lineType":1,"content":"佛氏棄君臣、父子、夫婦之道，豈自然之理哉？","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1105","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7619018243773481002"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1106","lineNum":1515,"lineType":1,"content":"智哉留侯，善藏其用。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1107","lineNum":1517,"lineType":1,"content":"漢儒以反經合道為權，得一端者也。權所以平物之輕","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1108","lineNum":1519,"lineType":1,"content":"重，聖人行權，酌其輕重而行之，合其宜而已。故執中無","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1109","lineNum":1521,"lineType":1,"content":"權者，猶為偏也。王通言春秋王道之權，非王通莫能及","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1110","lineNum":1523,"lineType":1,"content":"此。故權在一身，則有一身之權，在一鄉，則有一鄉之權，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1111","lineNum":1525,"lineType":1,"content":"以至於天下，則有天下之權。用雖不同，其權一也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1112","lineNum":1527,"lineType":1,"content":"文中子曰：易樂者必多哀，輕施者必好奪。或曰：天下皆","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1113","lineNum":1529,"lineType":1,"content":"爭利棄義，吾獨若之何？子曰：舍其所爭，取其所棄，不亦","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1114","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7619018243773497386"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1115","lineNum":1533,"lineType":1,"content":"君子乎？若此之類，禮義之言也。心迹之判久矣，若此之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1116","lineNum":1535,"lineType":1,"content":"類，造化之言也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1117","lineNum":1537,"lineType":1,"content":"太𤣥九日當兩卦，餘一卦當四日半。揚雄作𤣥，可謂見","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1118","lineNum":1539,"lineType":1,"content":"天地之心者也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1119","lineNum":1541,"lineType":1,"content":"洛下閎改顓頊厯為太初厯，子雲準太初作太𤣥，凡八","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1120","lineNum":1543,"lineType":1,"content":"十一卦，九分共二卦，凡一五隔一四，細分之，則四分半","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1121","lineNum":1545,"lineType":1,"content":"當一卦。氣起於中心，故首中卦","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1122","lineNum":1547,"lineType":1,"content":"厯不能無差。今之學厯者，但知厯法，不知厯理。能布算","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1123","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7619018243773513770"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1124","lineNum":1551,"lineType":1,"content":"者，洛下閎也。能推步者，甘公、石公也。洛下閎但知厯法，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1125","lineNum":1553,"lineType":1,"content":"揚雄知厯法，又知厯理。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1126","lineNum":1555,"lineType":1,"content":"五星之說，自甘公、石公始也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1127","lineNum":1557,"lineType":1,"content":"素問、","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1128","lineNum":1557,"lineType":1,"content":"隂符，七國時書也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1129","lineNum":1559,"lineType":1,"content":"素問密語之類，於術之理可謂至矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1130","lineNum":1561,"lineType":1,"content":"韻法闔闢者律天，清濁者呂地。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1131","lineNum":1563,"lineType":1,"content":"韻法：先閉後開者，春也；純開者，夏也；先開後閉者，秋也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1132","lineNum":1565,"lineType":1,"content":"冬則閉而無聲。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1133","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7619018243773530154"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1134","lineNum":1569,"lineType":1,"content":"東為春聲，陽為夏聲，此見作韻者亦有所至矣。銜凡，冬","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1135","lineNum":1571,"lineType":1,"content":"聲也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1136","lineNum":1573,"lineType":1,"content":"皇極經世書卷十三，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7619018691355803686"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2","lineNum":3,"lineType":1,"content":"欽定四庫全書","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"3","lineNum":4,"lineType":4,"content":"皇極經世書卷十四","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"4","lineNum":5,"lineType":7,"content":"宋邵雍撰","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"5","lineNum":7,"lineType":8,"content":"觀物外篇下","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"6","lineNum":9,"lineType":1,"content":"太極，一也，不動，生二，二則神也。神生數，數生象，象生器。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"7","lineNum":11,"lineType":1,"content":"太極不動，性也。發則神，神則數，數則象，象則器，器之變","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"8","lineNum":13,"lineType":1,"content":"復歸於神也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"9","lineNum":15,"lineType":1,"content":"心為太極，又曰道為太極。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"10","lineNum":17,"lineType":1,"content":"太極，道之極也。太𤣥，道之𤣥也。太素，色之本也。太一，數","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"11","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7619018691355820070"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"12","lineNum":21,"lineType":1,"content":"之始也。太初，事之初也。其成功則一也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"13","lineNum":23,"lineType":1,"content":"元有二：有生天地之始，太極也；有萬物之中各有始者，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"14","lineNum":25,"lineType":1,"content":"生之本也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"15","lineNum":27,"lineType":1,"content":"萬物各有太極、兩儀、四象、八卦之次，亦有古今之象。隂","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"16","lineNum":29,"lineType":1,"content":"陽分而生二儀，二儀交而生四象，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"17","lineNum":29,"lineType":1,"content":"四象交而生八卦，八","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"18","lineNum":31,"lineType":1,"content":"卦交而生萬物。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"19","lineNum":31,"lineType":1,"content":"故二儀生天地之類，四象定天地之體；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"20","lineNum":33,"lineType":1,"content":"四象生八卦之類，八卦定日月之體。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"21","lineNum":33,"lineType":1,"content":"八卦生萬物之類，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"22","lineNum":35,"lineType":1,"content":"重卦定萬物之體。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"23","lineNum":35,"lineType":1,"content":"類者，生之序也；體者，象之交也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"24","lineNum":35,"lineType":1,"content":"推類","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"25","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7619018691355836454"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"26","lineNum":39,"lineType":1,"content":"者必本乎生，觀體者必由乎象。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"27","lineNum":39,"lineType":1,"content":"生則未來而逆推，象則","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"28","lineNum":41,"lineType":1,"content":"既成而順觀。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"29","lineNum":41,"lineType":1,"content":"是故日月一類也，同出而異處也，異處而","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"30","lineNum":43,"lineType":1,"content":"同象也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"31","lineNum":43,"lineType":1,"content":"推此以往，物焉逃哉？","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"32","lineNum":45,"lineType":1,"content":"天變時而地應物，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"33","lineNum":45,"lineType":1,"content":"時則隂變而陽應，物則陽變而隂應，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"34","lineNum":47,"lineType":1,"content":"故時可逆知，物必順成。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"35","lineNum":47,"lineType":1,"content":"是以陽迎而隂隨，隂逆而陽順。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"36","lineNum":49,"lineType":1,"content":"本一氣也，生則為陽，消則為隂。故二者一而已矣，六者","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"37","lineNum":51,"lineType":1,"content":"三而已矣，八者四而已矣。是以言天而不言地，言君而","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"38","lineNum":53,"lineType":1,"content":"不言臣，言父而不言子，言夫而不言婦也。然天得地而","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"39","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7619018691355852838"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"40","lineNum":57,"lineType":1,"content":"萬物生，君得臣而萬化行，父得子、夫得婦而家道成。故","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"41","lineNum":59,"lineType":1,"content":"有一則有二，有二則有四，有三則有六，有四則有八。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"42","lineNum":61,"lineType":1,"content":"語其體，則天分而為地，地分而為萬物，而道不可分也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"43","lineNum":63,"lineType":1,"content":"其終則萬物歸地，地歸天，天歸道，是以君子貴道也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"44","lineNum":65,"lineType":1,"content":"一隂一陽之謂道，道無聲無形，不可得而見者也，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"45","lineNum":65,"lineType":1,"content":"故假","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"46","lineNum":67,"lineType":1,"content":"道路之道而為名。人之有行，必由乎道。一隂一陽，天地","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"47","lineNum":69,"lineType":1,"content":"之道也。物由是而生，由是而成者也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"48","lineNum":71,"lineType":1,"content":"陽者道之用，隂者，道之體。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"49","lineNum":71,"lineType":1,"content":"陽用隂，隂用陽。以陽為用則","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"50","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7619018691355869222"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"51","lineNum":75,"lineType":1,"content":"尊隂，以隂為用則尊陽也。隂幾於道，故以况道也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"52","lineNum":75,"lineType":1,"content":"陽尊","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"53","lineNum":77,"lineType":1,"content":"而神，尊故役物，神故藏用。是以道生天地萬物而不自","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"54","lineNum":79,"lineType":1,"content":"見也。萬物亦取法乎道也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"55","lineNum":81,"lineType":1,"content":"隂對陽為二，然陽來則生，陽去則死。天地萬物生死主","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"56","lineNum":83,"lineType":1,"content":"于陽，則歸之于一也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"57","lineNum":85,"lineType":1,"content":"自下而上謂之升，自上而下謂之降。升者生也，降者消","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"58","lineNum":87,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"59","lineNum":87,"lineType":1,"content":"故陽生於下而隂生於上，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"60","lineNum":87,"lineType":1,"content":"是以萬物皆反生。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"61","lineNum":87,"lineType":1,"content":"隂生陽，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"62","lineNum":89,"lineType":1,"content":"陽生隂，隂復生陽，陽復生隂，是以循環而無窮也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"63","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7619018691355885606"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"64","lineNum":93,"lineType":1,"content":"性非體不成，體非性不生。陽以隂為體，隂以陽為性。動","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"65","lineNum":95,"lineType":1,"content":"者，性也，静者，體也。在天則陽動而隂静，在地則陽静而","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"66","lineNum":97,"lineType":1,"content":"隂動。性得體而静，體隨性而動，是以陽舒而隂疾也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"67","lineNum":97,"lineType":2,"content":"更詳","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"68","lineNum":99,"lineType":2,"content":"之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"69","lineNum":101,"lineType":1,"content":"陽不能獨立，必得隂而後立，故陽以隂為基。隂不能自","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"70","lineNum":103,"lineType":1,"content":"見，必待陽而後見，故隂以陽為唱。陽知其始而享其成，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"71","lineNum":105,"lineType":1,"content":"隂效其法而終其用。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"72","lineNum":107,"lineType":1,"content":"陽能知而隂不能知，陽能見而隂不能見也。能知能見","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"73","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7619018691355901990"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"74","lineNum":111,"lineType":1,"content":"者為有，故陽性有而隂性無也。陽有所不徧，而隂無所","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"75","lineNum":113,"lineType":1,"content":"不徧也。陽有去而隂常居也。無不徧而常居者為實，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"76","lineNum":113,"lineType":1,"content":"故","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"77","lineNum":115,"lineType":1,"content":"陽體虛而隂體實也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"78","lineNum":117,"lineType":1,"content":"陽之類圓，成形則方；隂之類方，成形則圓。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"79","lineNum":119,"lineType":1,"content":"隂事太半，蓋陽一而隂二也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"80","lineNum":121,"lineType":1,"content":"陽主闢而出，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"81","lineNum":121,"lineType":1,"content":"隂主翕而入。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"82","lineNum":123,"lineType":1,"content":"春陽得權，故多旱。秋隂得權，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"83","lineNum":123,"lineType":1,"content":"故多雨。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"84","lineNum":125,"lineType":1,"content":"冬至之子中，隂之極。春分之卯中，陽之中。夏至之午中，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"85","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7619018691355918374"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"86","lineNum":129,"lineType":1,"content":"陽之極。秋分之酉中，隂之中。凡三百六十，中分之則一","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"87","lineNum":131,"lineType":1,"content":"百八十。此二至二分相去之數也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"88","lineNum":133,"lineType":1,"content":"二至相去，東西之度凡一百八十，南北之度凡六十。冬","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"89","lineNum":135,"lineType":1,"content":"至之後為呼，夏至之後為吸，此天地一歲之呼吸也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"90","lineNum":137,"lineType":1,"content":"朔易以陽氣自北方而生，至北方而盡，謂變易循環也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"91","lineNum":139,"lineType":1,"content":"東赤，南白，西黃，北黑，此正色也。驗之于曉午暮夜之時，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"92","lineNum":141,"lineType":1,"content":"可見之矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"93","lineNum":143,"lineType":1,"content":"天地之氣運，北而南則治，南而北則亂，亂久則復北而","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"94","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7619018691355934758"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"95","lineNum":147,"lineType":1,"content":"南矣。天道人事皆然，推之歴代，可見消長之理也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"96","lineNum":149,"lineType":1,"content":"天地之本，其起於中乎？是以乾坤屢變而不離乎中。人","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"97","lineNum":151,"lineType":1,"content":"居天地之中，心居人之中，日中則盛，月中則盈，故君子","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"98","lineNum":153,"lineType":1,"content":"貴中也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"99","lineNum":155,"lineType":1,"content":"生者性天也；成者形，地也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"100","lineNum":157,"lineType":1,"content":"得天氣者動，得地氣者靜。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"101","lineNum":159,"lineType":1,"content":"天以氣為主，體為次；地以體為主，氣為次。在天在地者","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"102","lineNum":161,"lineType":1,"content":"亦如之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"103","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7619018691355951142"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"104","lineNum":165,"lineType":1,"content":"天主用，地主體；聖人主用，百姓主體，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"105","lineNum":165,"lineType":1,"content":"故日用而不知。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"106","lineNum":167,"lineType":1,"content":"顯諸仁者，天地生萬物之功，則人可得而見也。所以造","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"107","lineNum":169,"lineType":1,"content":"萬物，則人不可得而見，是藏諸用也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"108","lineNum":171,"lineType":1,"content":"或問顯諸仁、藏諸用。曰：若日月之照臨，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"109","lineNum":171,"lineType":1,"content":"四時之成歲，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
