{"lines":[{"lineId":"110","lineNum":171,"lineType":1,"content":"是","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"111","lineNum":173,"lineType":1,"content":"顯諸仁也。其度數之然，而不知其所以然，是藏諸用也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"112","lineNum":175,"lineType":1,"content":"天之象類則可得而推，如其神用，則不可得而測也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"113","lineNum":177,"lineType":1,"content":"天以理盡，而不可以形盡，渾天之術，以形盡天，可乎？倚","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"114","lineNum":179,"lineType":1,"content":"葢之說，崑崙四𡸁","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"115","lineNum":179,"lineType":1,"content":"而為海，推之理則不然。夫地直方而","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"116","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7619018691355967526"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"117","lineNum":183,"lineType":1,"content":"静，豈得如圓動之天乎？","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"118","lineNum":185,"lineType":1,"content":"天圓而地方，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"119","lineNum":185,"lineType":1,"content":"天南高而北下，是以望之如倚蓋焉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"120","lineNum":185,"lineType":1,"content":"地東","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"121","lineNum":187,"lineType":1,"content":"南下，西北高，是以東南多水，西北多山也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"122","lineNum":187,"lineType":1,"content":"天覆地，地載","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"123","lineNum":189,"lineType":1,"content":"天，天地相函，故天上有地，地上有天。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"124","lineNum":191,"lineType":1,"content":"天之陽在南，故日處之；地剛在北，故山處之。所以地高","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"125","lineNum":193,"lineType":1,"content":"西北，天高東南也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"126","lineNum":195,"lineType":1,"content":"天之陽在南而隂在北，地之隂在南而陽在北，人之陽","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"127","lineNum":197,"lineType":1,"content":"在上而隂在下，既交則陽下而隂上。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"128","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7619018691355983910"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"129","lineNum":201,"lineType":1,"content":"極南大暑，極北大寒，故南融而北結，萬物之死地也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"130","lineNum":203,"lineType":1,"content":"夏則日隨斗而北，冬則日隨斗而南，故天地交而寒暑","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"131","lineNum":205,"lineType":1,"content":"和，寒暑和而物乃生也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"132","lineNum":207,"lineType":1,"content":"天渾渾於上而不可測也，故觀斗數以占天也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"133","lineNum":207,"lineType":1,"content":"斗之所","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"134","lineNum":209,"lineType":1,"content":"建，天之行也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"135","lineNum":209,"lineType":1,"content":"魁建子，杓建寅，星以寅為晝也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"136","lineNum":209,"lineType":1,"content":"斗有七星，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"137","lineNum":211,"lineType":1,"content":"是以晝不過乎七分也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"138","lineNum":211,"lineType":2,"content":"更詳之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"139","lineNum":213,"lineType":1,"content":"天行所以為晝夜，日行所以為寒暑。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"140","lineNum":213,"lineType":1,"content":"夏淺冬深，天地之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"141","lineNum":215,"lineType":1,"content":"交也；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"142","lineNum":215,"lineType":1,"content":"左旋右行，天日之交也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"143","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7619018691356000294"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"144","lineNum":219,"lineType":1,"content":"日朝在東，夕在西，隨天之行也；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"145","lineNum":219,"lineType":1,"content":"夏在北，冬在南，隨天之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"146","lineNum":221,"lineType":1,"content":"交也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"147","lineNum":221,"lineType":1,"content":"天一周而超一星，應日之行也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"148","lineNum":221,"lineType":1,"content":"春酉正，夏午正，秋","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"149","lineNum":223,"lineType":1,"content":"卯正，冬子正，應日之交也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"150","lineNum":225,"lineType":1,"content":"冬至之月，所行如夏至之日；夏至之月，所行如冬至之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"151","lineNum":227,"lineType":1,"content":"日。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"152","lineNum":229,"lineType":1,"content":"陽主舒長，隂主慘急。日入盈度，隂從于陽；日入縮度，陽","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"153","lineNum":231,"lineType":1,"content":"從于隂。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"154","lineNum":233,"lineType":1,"content":"日行陽度則盈，行隂度則縮，賓主之道也。月去日則明","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"155","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7619018691356016678"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"156","lineNum":237,"lineType":1,"content":"生而遲，近日則魄生而疾，君臣之道也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"157","lineNum":239,"lineType":1,"content":"日以遲為進，月以疾為退。日月一㑹而加半日，減半日，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"158","lineNum":241,"lineType":1,"content":"是以為閏餘也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"159","lineNum":241,"lineType":1,"content":"日一大運而進六日，月一大運而退六","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"160","lineNum":243,"lineType":1,"content":"日，是以為閏差也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"161","lineNum":245,"lineType":1,"content":"一歲之閏，六隂六陽。三年三十六日，故三年一閏。五年","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"162","lineNum":247,"lineType":1,"content":"六十日，故五年再閏。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"163","lineNum":249,"lineType":1,"content":"堯典：朞三百六旬有六日。夫日之餘盈也六，則月之餘","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"164","lineNum":251,"lineType":1,"content":"縮也亦六。若去日月之餘十二，則有三百五十四，乃日","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"165","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7619018691356033062"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"166","lineNum":255,"lineType":1,"content":"行之數，以十二除之，則得二十九日。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"167","lineNum":257,"lineType":1,"content":"陽消則生隂，故日下而月西出也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"168","lineNum":257,"lineType":1,"content":"隂盛則敵陽，故日望","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"169","lineNum":259,"lineType":1,"content":"而月東出也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"170","lineNum":259,"lineType":1,"content":"天為父，日為子，故天左旋，日右行。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"171","lineNum":259,"lineType":1,"content":"日為夫，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"172","lineNum":261,"lineType":1,"content":"月為婦，故日東出，月西生也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"173","lineNum":263,"lineType":1,"content":"日月之相食，數之交也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"174","lineNum":263,"lineType":1,"content":"日望月則月食，月掩日則日食，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"175","lineNum":265,"lineType":1,"content":"猶水火之相尅也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"176","lineNum":265,"lineType":1,"content":"是以君子用智，小人用力。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"177","lineNum":267,"lineType":1,"content":"月體本黑，受日之光，故白","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"178","lineNum":269,"lineType":1,"content":"日入地中，搆精之象也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"179","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7619018691356049446"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"180","lineNum":273,"lineType":1,"content":"日隨天而轉，月隨日而行，星隨月而見。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"181","lineNum":273,"lineType":1,"content":"故星法月，月法","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"182","lineNum":275,"lineType":1,"content":"日，日法天。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"183","lineNum":275,"lineType":1,"content":"天半明半晦，半盈半縮，月半盈半𧇊，星半動","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"184","lineNum":277,"lineType":1,"content":"半静，隂陽之義也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"185","lineNum":277,"lineType":1,"content":"天晝夜常見，日見於晝，月見於夜而","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"186","lineNum":279,"lineType":1,"content":"半不見，星半見於夜，貴賤之等也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"187","lineNum":281,"lineType":1,"content":"月，晝可見也，故為陽中之隂。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"188","lineNum":281,"lineType":1,"content":"星，夜可見也，故為隂中之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"189","lineNum":283,"lineType":1,"content":"陽。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"190","lineNum":285,"lineType":1,"content":"陽中有隂，隂中有陽，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"191","lineNum":285,"lineType":1,"content":"天之道也。陽中之陽，日也，暑之道","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"192","lineNum":287,"lineType":1,"content":"也。陽中之隂，月也，以其陽之類，故能見于晝。隂中之陽，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"193","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7619018691356065830"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"194","lineNum":291,"lineType":1,"content":"星也，所以見於夜。隂中之隂，辰也，天壤也，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"195","lineNum":293,"lineType":1,"content":"辰數十二，日月交㑹謂之辰。辰，天之體也。天之體，無物","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"196","lineNum":295,"lineType":1,"content":"之氣也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"197","lineNum":297,"lineType":1,"content":"辰至日為生，日至辰為用，蓋順為生而逆為用也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"198","lineNum":299,"lineType":1,"content":"星為日餘，辰為月餘。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"199","lineNum":301,"lineType":1,"content":"星之至微如塵沙者，隕而為堆阜。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"200","lineNum":303,"lineType":1,"content":"天奇而地耦，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"201","lineNum":303,"lineType":1,"content":"是以占天文者，觀星而已，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"202","lineNum":303,"lineType":1,"content":"察地理者，觀山","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"203","lineNum":305,"lineType":1,"content":"水而已。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"204","lineNum":305,"lineType":1,"content":"觀星而天體見矣，觀山水而地體見矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"205","lineNum":305,"lineType":1,"content":"天體容","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"206","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7619018691356082214"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"207","lineNum":309,"lineType":1,"content":"物，地體負物，是故體幾於道也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"208","lineNum":311,"lineType":1,"content":"日月星、辰共，為天，水火、土石共，為地，耳目鼻口共，為首，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"209","lineNum":313,"lineType":1,"content":"髓血筋骨共，為身。此乃五之數也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"210","lineNum":315,"lineType":1,"content":"天有五辰，日、月、星、辰與天而為五。地有五行，金、木、水、火","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"211","lineNum":317,"lineType":1,"content":"與土而為五。五行之木，萬物之類也。五行之金，出乎石","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"212","lineNum":319,"lineType":1,"content":"也。故水火土石不及金木，金木生其間也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"213","lineNum":321,"lineType":1,"content":"陽中陽，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"214","lineNum":321,"lineType":1,"content":"日也；陽中隂，月也；隂中陽，星也；隂中隂，辰也。柔","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"215","lineNum":323,"lineType":1,"content":"中柔，水也；柔中剛，火也；剛中柔，土也；剛中剛，石也。夫四","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"216","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7619018691356098598"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"217","lineNum":327,"lineType":1,"content":"象在錯綜而用之。日月，天之隂陽；水火，地之隂陽；星辰，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"218","lineNum":329,"lineType":1,"content":"天之剛柔。土石，地之剛柔。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"219","lineNum":331,"lineType":1,"content":"天之陽在東南，日月居之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"220","lineNum":331,"lineType":1,"content":"地之隂在西北，火石處之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"221","lineNum":331,"lineType":1,"content":"天","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"222","lineNum":333,"lineType":1,"content":"以剛為德，故柔者不見。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"223","lineNum":333,"lineType":1,"content":"地以柔為體，故剛者不主。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"224","lineNum":333,"lineType":1,"content":"是以","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"225","lineNum":335,"lineType":1,"content":"震，天之隂也，巽，地之陽也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"226","lineNum":337,"lineType":1,"content":"地，隂也，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"227","lineNum":337,"lineType":1,"content":"有陽而隂效之，故至隂者辰也，至陽者日也。皆","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"228","lineNum":339,"lineType":1,"content":"在乎天，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"229","lineNum":339,"lineType":1,"content":"而地則水火而已。是以地上皆有質之物，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"230","lineNum":339,"lineType":1,"content":"隂伏","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"231","lineNum":341,"lineType":1,"content":"陽而形質生，陽伏隂而性情生。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"232","lineNum":341,"lineType":1,"content":"是以陽生隂，隂生陽，陽","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"233","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7619018691356114982"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"234","lineNum":345,"lineType":1,"content":"尅隂，隂尅陽。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"235","lineNum":345,"lineType":1,"content":"陽之不可伏者，不見於地，隂之不可尅者，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"236","lineNum":347,"lineType":1,"content":"不見於天。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"237","lineNum":347,"lineType":1,"content":"伏陽之少者，其體必柔，是以畏陽而為陽所","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"238","lineNum":349,"lineType":1,"content":"用。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"239","lineNum":349,"lineType":1,"content":"伏陽之多者，其體必剛，是以禦陽而為隂所用。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"240","lineNum":349,"lineType":1,"content":"故水","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"241","lineNum":351,"lineType":1,"content":"火動而隨陽，土石静而隨隂也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"242","lineNum":351,"lineType":2,"content":"一說云隂效","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"243","lineNum":351,"lineType":2,"content":"陽而能伏，是以辰在天，而地之四","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"244","lineNum":353,"lineType":2,"content":"物皆有所欠也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"245","lineNum":355,"lineType":1,"content":"陽生隂，故水先成。隂生陽，故火後成。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"246","lineNum":355,"lineType":1,"content":"隂陽相生也，體性","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"247","lineNum":357,"lineType":1,"content":"相湏也。是以陽去則隂竭，隂盡則陽滅。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"248","lineNum":359,"lineType":1,"content":"火以性為主，體次之。水以體為主，性次之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"249","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7619018691356131366"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"250","lineNum":363,"lineType":1,"content":"天火，無體之火也。地火，有體之火也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"251","lineNum":365,"lineType":1,"content":"火無體，因物以為體。金石之火，烈于草木之火者，因物","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"252","lineNum":367,"lineType":1,"content":"而然也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"253","lineNum":369,"lineType":1,"content":"火生于無，水生于有。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"254","lineNum":371,"lineType":1,"content":"海潮者，地之喘息也。所以應月者，從其類也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"255","lineNum":373,"lineType":1,"content":"燈之明暗之境，日月之象也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"256","lineNum":375,"lineType":1,"content":"水者，火之地。火者，水之氣。黑者，白之地。寒者，暑之地。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"257","lineNum":377,"lineType":1,"content":"月者，日之影也。情者，性之影也。隂者，陽之影。鬼者，人之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"258","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7619018691356147750"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"259","lineNum":381,"lineType":1,"content":"影也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"260","lineNum":383,"lineType":1,"content":"明則有日月，幽則有鬼神。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"261","lineNum":385,"lineType":1,"content":"鬼神者，無形而有用，其情狀可得而知也，於用則可見","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"262","lineNum":387,"lineType":1,"content":"之矣。若人之耳目鼻口手足，草木之枝葉華實顏色，皆","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"263","lineNum":389,"lineType":1,"content":"鬼神之所為也。福善禍淫，主之者誰耶？聰明正直，有之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"264","lineNum":391,"lineType":1,"content":"者誰邪？","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"265","lineNum":391,"lineType":1,"content":"不疾而速，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"266","lineNum":391,"lineType":1,"content":"不行而至，任之者誰邪？皆鬼神之情","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"267","lineNum":393,"lineType":1,"content":"狀也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"268","lineNum":395,"lineType":1,"content":"天地之心者，生萬物之本也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"269","lineNum":395,"lineType":1,"content":"天地之情者，情狀也，與鬼","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"270","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7619018691356164134"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"271","lineNum":399,"lineType":1,"content":"神之情狀同。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"272","lineNum":401,"lineType":1,"content":"以天地生萬物，則以萬物為萬物。以道生天地，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"273","lineNum":401,"lineType":1,"content":"則天地","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"274","lineNum":403,"lineType":1,"content":"亦萬物也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"275","lineNum":405,"lineType":1,"content":"天地生萬物，聖人生萬民。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"276","lineNum":407,"lineType":1,"content":"生生長類，天地成功。别生分類，聖人成能。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"277","lineNum":409,"lineType":1,"content":"動物自首生，植物自根生。自首生，命在首。自根生，命在","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"278","lineNum":411,"lineType":1,"content":"根。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"279","lineNum":413,"lineType":1,"content":"本乎天者親上，本乎地者親下。故變之與應常反對也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"280","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7619018691356180518"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"281","lineNum":417,"lineType":1,"content":"有變則必有應也。故變于內者應于外，變于外者應于","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"282","lineNum":419,"lineType":1,"content":"內，變于下者應于上，變于上者應于下也。天變而日應","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"283","lineNum":421,"lineType":1,"content":"之，故變者從天而應者法日也。是以日紀乎星，月㑹於","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"284","lineNum":423,"lineType":1,"content":"辰，水生於土，火潛於石，飛者棲木，走者依草，心肺之相","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"285","lineNum":425,"lineType":1,"content":"聯，肝膽之相屬，無它，變應之道也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"286","lineNum":427,"lineType":1,"content":"陽交於隂而生，蹄角之類也。剛交於柔而生，根荄之類","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"287","lineNum":429,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"288","lineNum":429,"lineType":1,"content":"隂交於陽而生，羽翼之類也。柔交於剛而生，枝榦之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"289","lineNum":431,"lineType":1,"content":"類也。天交於地，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"290","lineNum":431,"lineType":1,"content":"地交於天，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"291","lineNum":431,"lineType":1,"content":"故有羽而走者，足而騰者，草","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"292","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7619018789597741083"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"293","lineNum":435,"lineType":1,"content":"中有木，木中有草也。各以類而推之，則生物之類不過","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"294","lineNum":437,"lineType":1,"content":"是矣。走者便於下，飛者利於上，從其類也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"295","lineNum":437,"lineType":1,"content":"水之物無異","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"296","lineNum":439,"lineType":1,"content":"乎陸之物，各有寒熱之性，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"297","lineNum":439,"lineType":1,"content":"大較則陸為陽中之隂，而水","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"298","lineNum":441,"lineType":1,"content":"為隂中之陽。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"299","lineNum":443,"lineType":1,"content":"陸中之物，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"300","lineNum":443,"lineType":1,"content":"水中必具者，猶影象也。陸多走，水多飛者，交","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"301","lineNum":445,"lineType":1,"content":"也。是故巨于陸者必細于水，巨于水者必細于陸也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"302","lineNum":447,"lineType":1,"content":"水之族以隂為主，陽次之；陸之類以陽為主，隂次之。故","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"303","lineNum":449,"lineType":1,"content":"水類出水則死，風類入水則死。然有出入之類者，龜蟹","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"304","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7619018789597757467"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"305","lineNum":453,"lineType":1,"content":"鵝鳬之類是也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"306","lineNum":455,"lineType":1,"content":"魚在于水則生，離則死，交與不交之謂也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"307","lineNum":457,"lineType":1,"content":"魚者，水之族也。蟲者，風之族也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"308","lineNum":459,"lineType":1,"content":"風類水類，小大相反。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"309","lineNum":461,"lineType":1,"content":"在水者不瞑，在風者瞑。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"310","lineNum":461,"lineType":1,"content":"走之類上睫接下，飛之類下睫","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"311","lineNum":463,"lineType":1,"content":"接上，類使之然也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"312","lineNum":465,"lineType":1,"content":"在水而鱗鬣，飛之類也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"313","lineNum":465,"lineType":1,"content":"龜獺之類，走之類也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"314","lineNum":467,"lineType":1,"content":"飛之類喜風而敏于飛上，走之類喜土而利于走下。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"315","lineNum":467,"lineType":1,"content":"飛","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"316","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7619018789597773851"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"317","lineNum":471,"lineType":1,"content":"之走，鷄鳧之類是也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"318","lineNum":471,"lineType":1,"content":"走之飛，龍馬之屬是也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"319","lineNum":473,"lineType":1,"content":"馬牛皆隂類，細分之，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"320","lineNum":473,"lineType":1,"content":"則馬為陽而牛為隂。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"321","lineNum":475,"lineType":1,"content":"鷹雕之類食生，而鷄鳧之類不專食生。虎豹之類食生，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"322","lineNum":477,"lineType":1,"content":"而貓犬之類食生又食穀。以類推之，從可知矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"323","lineNum":479,"lineType":1,"content":"虎豹之毛猶草也，鷹鸇之羽猶木也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"324","lineNum":481,"lineType":1,"content":"草伏之獸，毛如草之莖；林棲之鳥，羽如林之葉。類使之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"325","lineNum":483,"lineType":1,"content":"然也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"326","lineNum":485,"lineType":1,"content":"禽蟲之卵，果穀之類也。穀之類多子，蟲之類亦然。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"327","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7619018789597790235"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"328","lineNum":489,"lineType":1,"content":"蠶之類，今歲蛾而子，來歲則子而蠶。蕪菁之類，今歲根","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"329","lineNum":491,"lineType":1,"content":"而苖，來歲則苖而子。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"330","lineNum":493,"lineType":1,"content":"木者，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"331","lineNum":493,"lineType":1,"content":"星之子，是以果實象也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"332","lineNum":495,"lineType":1,"content":"木之支榦，土石之所成，所以不易。葉花，水火之所盛，故","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"333","lineNum":497,"lineType":1,"content":"變而易也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"334","lineNum":499,"lineType":1,"content":"葉，隂也。華實，陽也。枝葉耎而根榦堅也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"335","lineNum":501,"lineType":1,"content":"木之堅，非雷不能震。草之柔，非露不能潤。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"336","lineNum":503,"lineType":1,"content":"草類之細，入于坤。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"337","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7619018789597806619"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"338","lineNum":507,"lineType":1,"content":"水之木，珊瑚之類是也。石之花，監法之類是也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"339","lineNum":509,"lineType":1,"content":"龍能大能小，然亦有制之者，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"340","lineNum":509,"lineType":1,"content":"受制於隂陽之氣，得時則","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"341","lineNum":511,"lineType":1,"content":"能變化，變變則不能也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"342","lineNum":513,"lineType":1,"content":"有一日之物，有一月之物，有一時之物，有一歲之物，有","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"343","lineNum":515,"lineType":1,"content":"十嵗之物，至於百千萬皆有之。天地亦物也，亦有數焉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"344","lineNum":517,"lineType":1,"content":"雀三年之物，馬三十年之物，凡飛走之物，皆可以數推。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"345","lineNum":519,"lineType":1,"content":"人百有二十年之物，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"346","lineNum":521,"lineType":1,"content":"人為萬物之靈，寄類於走。走，隂也，故百有二十","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"347","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7619018789597823003"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"348","lineNum":525,"lineType":1,"content":"人寓形於走類，何也？走類者，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"349","lineNum":525,"lineType":1,"content":"地之長子也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"350","lineNum":527,"lineType":1,"content":"動者體横，植者體縱，人宜横而反縱也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"351","lineNum":529,"lineType":1,"content":"人之骨巨而體繁，木之榦巨而葉繁，應天地之數也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"352","lineNum":531,"lineType":1,"content":"飛者有翅，走者有趾。人之兩手，翅也；兩足，趾也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"353","lineNum":533,"lineType":1,"content":"飛者食木，走者食草。人皆兼之，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"354","lineNum":533,"lineType":1,"content":"而又食飛走也，故最貴","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"355","lineNum":535,"lineType":1,"content":"於萬物也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"356","lineNum":537,"lineType":1,"content":"天六地四。天以氣為質，而以神為神，地以質為質，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"357","lineNum":537,"lineType":1,"content":"而以","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"358","lineNum":539,"lineType":1,"content":"氣為神。唯人兼乎萬物，而為萬物之靈。如禽獸之聲，以","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"359","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7619018789597839387"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"360","lineNum":543,"lineType":1,"content":"其類而各能得其一。無所不能者，人也。推之他事，亦莫","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"361","lineNum":545,"lineType":1,"content":"不然。唯人得天地日月交之用，他類則不能也。人之生，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"362","lineNum":547,"lineType":1,"content":"真可謂之貴矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"363","lineNum":547,"lineType":1,"content":"天地與其貴而不自貴，是悖天地之理，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"364","lineNum":549,"lineType":1,"content":"不祥莫大焉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"365","lineNum":551,"lineType":1,"content":"天有四時，地有四方，人有四支。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"366","lineNum":551,"lineType":1,"content":"是以指節可以觀天，掌","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"367","lineNum":553,"lineType":1,"content":"文可以察地。天地之理具乎指掌矣，可不貴之哉？人之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"368","lineNum":555,"lineType":1,"content":"四支，各有脉也，一脉三部，一部三候，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"369","lineNum":555,"lineType":1,"content":"以應天數也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"370","lineNum":557,"lineType":1,"content":"身，地也，本乎静，所以能動者，氣血使之然也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"371","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7619018789597855771"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"372","lineNum":561,"lineType":1,"content":"水在人之身為血，土在人之身為肉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"373","lineNum":563,"lineType":1,"content":"日為心，月為膽，星為脾，辰為腎，藏也；石為肺，土為肝，火","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"374","lineNum":565,"lineType":1,"content":"為胃，水為膀胱，府也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"375","lineNum":567,"lineType":1,"content":"天地並行，則藏府配。四藏，天也；四府，地也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"376","lineNum":569,"lineType":1,"content":"藏者，天行也；府者，地行也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"377","lineNum":569,"lineType":1,"content":"天地並行，則配為八卦。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"378","lineNum":571,"lineType":1,"content":"體必交而後生，故陽與剛交而生心肺，陽與柔交而生","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"379","lineNum":573,"lineType":1,"content":"肝膽，柔與隂交而生腎與膀胱，剛與隂交而生脾胃。心","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"380","lineNum":575,"lineType":1,"content":"生目，膽生耳，脾生鼻，腎生口，肺生骨，肝生肉，胃生體，膀","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"381","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7619018789597872155"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"382","lineNum":579,"lineType":1,"content":"胱生血。故乾為心，兌為脾，離為膽，震為腎，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"383","lineNum":579,"lineType":1,"content":"坤為血，艮為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"384","lineNum":581,"lineType":1,"content":"肉，坎為髓，巽為骨，泰為目，中孚為鼻，既濟為耳，頤為口，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"385","lineNum":583,"lineType":1,"content":"大過為肺，未濟為胃，小過為肝，否為膀胱。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"386","lineNum":585,"lineType":1,"content":"天地有八象，人有十六象，何也？合天地而生人，合父母","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"387","lineNum":587,"lineType":1,"content":"而生子，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"388","lineNum":587,"lineType":1,"content":"故有十六象也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"389","lineNum":589,"lineType":1,"content":"心居肺，膽居肝，何也？言性者必歸之天，言體者必歸之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"390","lineNum":591,"lineType":1,"content":"地。地中有天，石中有火，是以心膽象之也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"391","lineNum":593,"lineType":1,"content":"心膽之倒懸，何也？草木者，地之本體也，人與草木反生，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"392","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7619018789597888539"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"393","lineNum":597,"lineType":1,"content":"是以倒懸也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"394","lineNum":599,"lineType":1,"content":"口目横而鼻耳縱何也？體必交也。故動者宜縱而反横，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"395","lineNum":601,"lineType":1,"content":"植者宜横而反縱，皆交也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"396","lineNum":603,"lineType":1,"content":"目口凸而耳鼻竅，竅者受臭嗅氣，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"397","lineNum":603,"lineType":1,"content":"物或不能閉之；凸者","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"398","lineNum":605,"lineType":1,"content":"視色別味，物則能閉之也。四者雖象於一，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"399","lineNum":605,"lineType":1,"content":"而各備其四","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"400","lineNum":607,"lineType":1,"content":"矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"401","lineNum":609,"lineType":1,"content":"鼻之氣，目見之，口之言，耳聞之，以類應也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"402","lineNum":611,"lineType":1,"content":"膽與腎同隂，心與脾同陽。心主目，脾主鼻。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"403","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7619018789597904923"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"404","lineNum":615,"lineType":1,"content":"素問：肺主皮毛。心脉，脾肉，肝筯，腎骨，上而下，外而內也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"405","lineNum":617,"lineType":1,"content":"心血腎骨，交法也，交卽用也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"406","lineNum":619,"lineType":1,"content":"心藏神，腎藏精，脾藏䰟，膽藏魄，胃受物而化之，傳氣於","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"407","lineNum":621,"lineType":1,"content":"肺，傳血於肝，而傳水穀於脬腸矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"408","lineNum":623,"lineType":1,"content":"神者人之主，将寐在脾，熟寐在腎，将寤在膽，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"409","lineNum":623,"lineType":2,"content":"又言在肝。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"410","lineNum":623,"lineType":1,"content":"正寤","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"411","lineNum":625,"lineType":1,"content":"在心。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"412","lineNum":627,"lineType":1,"content":"天之神棲乎日，人之神棲乎目；人之神寤則棲心，寐則","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"413","lineNum":629,"lineType":1,"content":"棲腎，所以象天，此晝夜之道也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"414","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7619018789597921307"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"415","lineNum":633,"lineType":1,"content":"天地之大寤在夏，人之神則存于心。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"416","lineNum":635,"lineType":1,"content":"神統於心，氣統於腎，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"417","lineNum":635,"lineType":1,"content":"行統於首，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"418","lineNum":635,"lineType":1,"content":"形氣交而神主乎其中，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"419","lineNum":637,"lineType":1,"content":"三才之道也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"420","lineNum":639,"lineType":1,"content":"氣一而已，主之者乾也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"421","lineNum":639,"lineType":1,"content":"神亦一而已，乘氣而變化，能出","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"422","lineNum":641,"lineType":1,"content":"入于有無死生之間，無方而不測者也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"423","lineNum":643,"lineType":1,"content":"潜天潜地，不行而至，不為隂陽所攝者，神也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"424","lineNum":643,"lineType":1,"content":"出入有無","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"425","lineNum":645,"lineType":1,"content":"死生者，道也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"426","lineNum":645,"lineType":1,"content":"神無所在，無所不在。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"427","lineNum":645,"lineType":1,"content":"至人與他心通者，以","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"428","lineNum":647,"lineType":1,"content":"其本於一也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"429","lineNum":647,"lineType":1,"content":"道與一，神之强名也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"430","lineNum":647,"lineType":1,"content":"以神為神者，至言也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"431","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7619018789597937691"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"432","lineNum":651,"lineType":1,"content":"所以造物者，神也，神不死。所更者四時也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"433","lineNum":651,"lineType":1,"content":"所以造人者，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"434","lineNum":653,"lineType":1,"content":"神人也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"435","lineNum":653,"lineType":1,"content":"神亦不死。假如一木結實而種之，又成是木而","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"436","lineNum":655,"lineType":1,"content":"結是實，木非舊木也，此木之神不二也，此實生生之理","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"437","lineNum":657,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"438","lineNum":657,"lineType":2,"content":"造","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"439","lineNum":657,"lineType":2,"content":"物，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"440","lineNum":657,"lineType":2,"content":"一作造萬物。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"441","lineNum":657,"lineType":2,"content":"神","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"442","lineNum":657,"lineType":2,"content":"人，一無","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"443","lineNum":657,"lineType":2,"content":"人字。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"444","lineNum":659,"lineType":1,"content":"氣者，神之宅也；體者，氣之宅也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"445","lineNum":661,"lineType":1,"content":"形可分，神不可分。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"446","lineNum":663,"lineType":1,"content":"精氣為物，形也；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"447","lineNum":663,"lineType":1,"content":"遊魂為變，神也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"448","lineNum":663,"lineType":1,"content":"又曰：精氣為物，體也；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"449","lineNum":663,"lineType":1,"content":"遊","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"450","lineNum":665,"lineType":1,"content":"魂為變，用也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"451","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7619018789597954075"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"452","lineNum":669,"lineType":1,"content":"氣形盛則魂魄盛，氣形衰則魂魄亦從而衰矣。魂隨氣","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"453","lineNum":671,"lineType":1,"content":"而變，魄隨形而止，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"454","lineNum":671,"lineType":1,"content":"故形在則魄存，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"455","lineNum":671,"lineType":1,"content":"形化則魄散。見氣變","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"456","lineNum":673,"lineType":1,"content":"而形化。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"457","lineNum":675,"lineType":1,"content":"人得中和之氣，則剛柔均。陽多則偏剛，隂多則偏柔。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"458","lineNum":677,"lineType":1,"content":"氣則養性，性則乗氣，故氣存則性存，性動則氣動也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"459","lineNum":679,"lineType":1,"content":"神無方而性有質。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"460","lineNum":681,"lineType":1,"content":"有形則有體，有性則有用。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"461","lineNum":683,"lineType":1,"content":"心性而膽情，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"462","lineNum":683,"lineType":1,"content":"陽性而隂情，性神而情鬼。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"463","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7619018789597970459"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"464","lineNum":687,"lineType":1,"content":"發于性則見于情，發于情則見於色，以類而應也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"465","lineNum":689,"lineType":1,"content":"天使我有是之謂命，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"466","lineNum":689,"lineType":1,"content":"命之在我之謂性，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"467","lineNum":689,"lineType":1,"content":"性之在物之謂","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"468","lineNum":691,"lineType":1,"content":"理。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"469","lineNum":693,"lineType":1,"content":"理窮而後知性，性盡而後知命，知而後至。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"470","lineNum":695,"lineType":1,"content":"人之類，備乎萬物之性；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"471","lineNum":697,"lineType":1,"content":"人之貴，兼乎萬類。自重而得其貴，所以能用萬類","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"472","lineNum":699,"lineType":1,"content":"巳。配天地謂之人，唯仁者其可謂之人矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"473","lineNum":701,"lineType":1,"content":"人之神則天地之神。人之自欺，所以欺天地，可不愼哉！","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"474","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7619018789597986843"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"475","lineNum":705,"lineType":1,"content":"人之精神，貴藏而用之，苟衒於外，則鮮有不敗者。如利","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"476","lineNum":707,"lineType":1,"content":"刃，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"477","lineNum":707,"lineType":1,"content":"物來則剸之。若恃刃之利而求割乎物，則刃與物俱","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"478","lineNum":709,"lineType":1,"content":"傷矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"479","lineNum":711,"lineType":1,"content":"精義入神，以致用也。不精義則不能入神，不能入神，則","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"480","lineNum":713,"lineType":1,"content":"不能致用也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"481","lineNum":715,"lineType":1,"content":"無思無為者，神妙致一之地也，所謂一以貫之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"482","lineNum":715,"lineType":1,"content":"聖人以","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"483","lineNum":717,"lineType":1,"content":"此洗心，退藏於密。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"484","lineNum":719,"lineType":1,"content":"心一而不分，則能應萬變，此君子所以虛心而不動也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"485","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7619018789598003227"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"486","lineNum":723,"lineType":1,"content":"人心當如止水則定，定則静，静則明。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"487","lineNum":725,"lineType":1,"content":"任我則情，情則蔽，蔽則昏矣。因物則性，性則神，神則明","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"488","lineNum":727,"lineType":1,"content":"矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"489","lineNum":729,"lineType":1,"content":"以物觀物，性也；以我觀物，情也。性公而明，情偏而暗。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"490","lineNum":731,"lineType":1,"content":"誠者，主性之具，無端無方者也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"491","lineNum":733,"lineType":1,"content":"資性，得之天也；學問，得之人也。資性由內出者也，學問","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"492","lineNum":735,"lineType":1,"content":"由外入者也。自誠明，性也；自明誠，學也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"493","lineNum":737,"lineType":1,"content":"至理之學，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"494","lineNum":737,"lineType":1,"content":"非至誠則不至。物理之學，或有所不通，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"495","lineNum":737,"lineType":1,"content":"不可","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"496","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7619018789598019611"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"497","lineNum":741,"lineType":1,"content":"以強通。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"498","lineNum":741,"lineType":1,"content":"𨿽通則有我，有我則失理而入於術矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"499","lineNum":743,"lineType":1,"content":"言發於真誠，則心不勞而逸，久久而信之。作僞任數，一","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"500","lineNum":745,"lineType":1,"content":"時或可以欺人，持久必敗。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"501","lineNum":747,"lineType":1,"content":"天地日月，悠久而已，故人當存乎遠，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"502","lineNum":747,"lineType":1,"content":"不可見其近。智數","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"503","lineNum":749,"lineType":1,"content":"或能施于一朝，葢有時而窮。惟至誠與天地同久，天地","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"504","lineNum":751,"lineType":1,"content":"無，則至誠可息。茍天地不能無，則至誠亦不息也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"505","lineNum":753,"lineType":1,"content":"為學養心，患在不由直道。去利欲，由直道，任至誠，則無","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"506","lineNum":755,"lineType":1,"content":"所不通。天地之道，直而已，當以求之。若用智數，由逕以","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"507","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7619018789598035995"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"508","lineNum":759,"lineType":1,"content":"求之，是屈天地而徇人欲也，不亦難乎？","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"509","lineNum":761,"lineType":1,"content":"人必內重，內重則外輕。茍內輕，必外重，好利好名，無所","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"510","lineNum":763,"lineType":1,"content":"不至。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"511","lineNum":765,"lineType":1,"content":"義重則內重，利重則外重。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"512","lineNum":767,"lineType":1,"content":"凡處失在得之先，則得亦不喜。若處得在失之先，則失","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"513","lineNum":769,"lineType":1,"content":"難處矣，必至於隕穫。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"514","lineNum":771,"lineType":1,"content":"天下之事，皆以道致之，則休戚不能至矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"515","lineNum":773,"lineType":1,"content":"事無大小，皆有道在其閒。能安分則謂之道，不能安分","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"516","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7619018789598052379"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"517","lineNum":777,"lineType":1,"content":"謂之非道。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"518","lineNum":779,"lineType":1,"content":"人之為道，當至於鬼神不能窺處，是為至矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"519","lineNum":781,"lineType":1,"content":"凡人之善惡，形于言，𤼵于行，人始得而知之。但萌諸心，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"520","lineNum":783,"lineType":1,"content":"𤼵于慮，鬼神已得而知之矣。此君子所以愼獨也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"521","lineNum":783,"lineType":2,"content":"又云：思慮","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"522","lineNum":785,"lineType":2,"content":"一萌，鬼神得而知","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"523","lineNum":785,"lineType":2,"content":"之矣。故君子不可不愼獨。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"524","lineNum":787,"lineType":1,"content":"人之畏鬼，亦猶鬼之畏人。人積善而陽多，鬼益畏之矣；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"525","lineNum":789,"lineType":1,"content":"積惡而陰多，鬼弗畏之矣。大人者，與鬼神合其吉凶，夫","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"526","lineNum":791,"lineType":1,"content":"何畏之有？","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"527","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7619018789598068763"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"528","lineNum":795,"lineType":1,"content":"循理則為常，理之外則為異矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"529","lineNum":797,"lineType":1,"content":"能循天理動者，造化在我也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"530","lineNum":799,"lineType":1,"content":"天下言讀書者不少，能讀書者少。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"531","lineNum":799,"lineType":1,"content":"若得天理眞樂，何書","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"532","lineNum":801,"lineType":1,"content":"不可讀？何堅不可破，何理不可精？","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"533","lineNum":803,"lineType":1,"content":"得天理者，不獨潤身，亦能潤心；不獨潤心，至於性命亦","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"534","lineNum":805,"lineType":1,"content":"潤。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"535","lineNum":807,"lineType":1,"content":"君子之學，以潤身為本，其治人應物，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"536","lineNum":807,"lineType":1,"content":"皆餘事也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"537","lineNum":809,"lineType":1,"content":"一國、一家、一身皆同。能處一身，則能處一家；能處一家，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"538","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7619018789598085147"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"539","lineNum":813,"lineType":1,"content":"則能處一國；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"540","lineNum":813,"lineType":1,"content":"能處一國，則能處天下。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"541","lineNum":813,"lineType":1,"content":"心為身本，身為家","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"542","lineNum":815,"lineType":1,"content":"本，家為國本，國為天下本。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"543","lineNum":815,"lineType":1,"content":"心能運身，茍心所不欲，身能","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"544","lineNum":817,"lineType":1,"content":"行乎？","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"545","lineNum":819,"lineType":1,"content":"君子處𤱶畝，則行畎畝之事，居廟堂，則行廟堂之事，故","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"546","lineNum":821,"lineType":1,"content":"無入不自得。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"547","lineNum":823,"lineType":1,"content":"變從時而便天下之事，不失禮之大經，變從時而順天","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"548","lineNum":825,"lineType":1,"content":"下之理，不失義之大權者，君子之道也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"549","lineNum":827,"lineType":1,"content":"斂天下之智為智，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"550","lineNum":827,"lineType":1,"content":"斂天下之善為善，則廣矣。自用則小","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"551","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7619018789598101531"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"552","lineNum":831,"lineType":1,"content":"人患乎自滿，滿則止也。故禹不自滿假，所以為賢。雖學","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"553","lineNum":833,"lineType":1,"content":"亦當常若不足，不可臨深以為高也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"554","lineNum":835,"lineType":1,"content":"人必有德器，然後喜怒皆不妄。為卿相，爲匹夫，以至學","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"555","lineNum":837,"lineType":1,"content":"問高天下，亦若無有也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"556","lineNum":839,"lineType":1,"content":"無德者責人怨人易滿，滿則止也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"557","lineNum":841,"lineType":1,"content":"人貴有德，小人有才者有之矣。故才不可恃，德不可無。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"558","lineNum":843,"lineType":1,"content":"經綸天地之謂才，遠舉必至之謂志，幷包含容之謂量。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"559","lineNum":845,"lineType":1,"content":"剸割者，才力也；明辨者，智識也；寬弘者，德器也。三者不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"560","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7619018789598117915"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"561","lineNum":849,"lineType":1,"content":"可闕一。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"562","lineNum":851,"lineType":1,"content":"人茍用心，必有所得，獨有多寡之異，智識之有深淺也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"563","lineNum":853,"lineType":2,"content":"又云：凡人","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"564","lineNum":853,"lineType":2,"content":"用心者，必有所得，只是有多寡。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"565","lineNum":855,"lineType":1,"content":"事必量力，量力故能久。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"566","lineNum":857,"lineType":1,"content":"聖人利物而無我，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"567","lineNum":859,"lineType":1,"content":"易地而處，則無我也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"568","lineNum":861,"lineType":1,"content":"不我物，則能物物，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"569","lineNum":863,"lineType":1,"content":"以物喜物，以物悲物，此𤼵而中節也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"570","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7619018789598134299"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"571","lineNum":867,"lineType":1,"content":"人智强則物智弱。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"572","lineNum":869,"lineType":1,"content":"夫弓固有强弱，然一弓二人張之，則有力者以為弓弱，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"573","lineNum":871,"lineType":1,"content":"無力者以為弓强。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"574","lineNum":871,"lineType":1,"content":"故有力者不以己之力有餘而以為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"575","lineNum":873,"lineType":1,"content":"弓弱，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"576","lineNum":873,"lineType":1,"content":"無力者不以己之力不足而以為弓强。何不思之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"577","lineNum":875,"lineType":1,"content":"甚也！","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"578","lineNum":875,"lineType":1,"content":"一弓非有强弱者，二人之力強弱不同也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"579","lineNum":875,"lineType":1,"content":"今有食","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"580","lineNum":877,"lineType":1,"content":"一杯在前，二人大餒而見之，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"581","lineNum":877,"lineType":1,"content":"若相讓，則均得食矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"582","lineNum":877,"lineType":1,"content":"相奪","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"583","lineNum":879,"lineType":1,"content":"則爭，非徒爭之而已，或不得其食矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"584","lineNum":879,"lineType":1,"content":"此二者，皆人之情","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"585","lineNum":881,"lineType":1,"content":"也，知之者鮮。知此，則天下之事皆如是也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"586","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7619018789598150683"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"587","lineNum":885,"lineType":1,"content":"金須百鍊然後精，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"588","lineNum":885,"lineType":1,"content":"人亦如此。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"589","lineNum":887,"lineType":1,"content":"今有人登兩臺，兩臺皆等，則不見其高，一臺高，然後知","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"590","lineNum":889,"lineType":1,"content":"其卑下者也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"591","lineNum":891,"lineType":1,"content":"室中造車，天下可行，軌轍合故也。茍順義理，合人情，日","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"592","lineNum":893,"lineType":1,"content":"月所照，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"593","lineNum":893,"lineType":1,"content":"皆可行也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"594","lineNum":895,"lineType":1,"content":"所行之路，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"595","lineNum":895,"lineType":1,"content":"不可不寬，寬則少礙。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"596","lineNum":897,"lineType":1,"content":"能醫人能醫之疾，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"597","lineNum":897,"lineType":1,"content":"不得謂之良醫。醫人之所不能醫者，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"598","lineNum":899,"lineType":1,"content":"天下之良醫也。能處人所不能處之事，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"599","lineNum":899,"lineType":1,"content":"則能為人所不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"600","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7619018789598167067"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"601","lineNum":903,"lineType":1,"content":"能為之事也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"602","lineNum":905,"lineType":1,"content":"良藥不可以離手，善言不可以離口。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"603","lineNum":907,"lineType":1,"content":"大羹可和，玄酒可漓，則是造化亦可和可漓也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"604","lineNum":909,"lineType":1,"content":"自然而然者，天也，唯聖人能索之。效法者，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"605","lineNum":909,"lineType":1,"content":"人也。若時行","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"606","lineNum":911,"lineType":1,"content":"時止，雖人也，亦天也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"607","lineNum":913,"lineType":1,"content":"人謀，人也；鬼謀，天也。天人同謀而皆可，則事成而吉也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"608","lineNum":915,"lineType":1,"content":"事無巨細，皆有天人之理。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"609","lineNum":915,"lineType":1,"content":"修身，人也；遇不遇，天也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"610","lineNum":915,"lineType":1,"content":"得失","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"611","lineNum":917,"lineType":1,"content":"不動心，所以順天也。行險僥倖，是逆天也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"612","lineNum":917,"lineType":1,"content":"求之者，人也，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"613","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7619018789598183451"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"614","lineNum":921,"lineType":1,"content":"得之與否，天也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"615","lineNum":921,"lineType":1,"content":"得失不動心，所以順天也。強取必得，是","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"616","lineNum":923,"lineType":1,"content":"逆天理也。逆天理者，患禍必至。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"617","lineNum":925,"lineType":1,"content":"天之孽，十之一猶可違；人之孽，十之九不可逭。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"618","lineNum":927,"lineType":1,"content":"天道之變，王道之權也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"619","lineNum":929,"lineType":1,"content":"為治之道，必通其變，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"620","lineNum":929,"lineType":1,"content":"不可以膠柱，猶春之時不可行冬","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"621","lineNum":931,"lineType":1,"content":"之令也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"622","lineNum":933,"lineType":1,"content":"用兵之道，必待人民富，倉廪實，府庫充，兵强名正，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"623","lineNum":933,"lineType":1,"content":"天時","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"624","lineNum":935,"lineType":1,"content":"順，地利得，然後可舉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"625","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7619018789598199835"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"626","lineNum":939,"lineType":1,"content":"天時、地理、人事三者，知之不易。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"627","lineNum":941,"lineType":1,"content":"學以人事為大，今之經典，古之人事也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"628","lineNum":943,"lineType":1,"content":"學不際天人，不足以謂之學。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"629","lineNum":945,"lineType":1,"content":"學不至於樂，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"630","lineNum":945,"lineType":1,"content":"不可謂之學。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"631","lineNum":947,"lineType":1,"content":"記問之學，未足以為事業。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"632","lineNum":949,"lineType":1,"content":"凡人為學，失於自主張太過，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"633","lineNum":951,"lineType":1,"content":"學在不止，故王通云沒身而已。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"634","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7619018789598216219"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"635","lineNum":955,"lineType":1,"content":"皇極經世書卷十四","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
